sentences.en: In 2011, the body of a woman was discovered in a California vineyard.
sentences.zh: 2011年，人们在加利福尼亚州的一处葡萄园里发现了一具女性尸体。

sentences.en: She had been decapitated, and her body had been drained of blood.
sentences.zh: 她被斩首，且体内的血液已被排干。

sentences.en: It appeared her killer had gone to extraordinary lengths to conceal her identity.
sentences.zh: 看来她的凶手费尽心思来掩盖她的身份。

sentences.en: For more than a decade, she was known only as Jane Doe.
sentences.zh: 在十多年的时间里，她只被称为无名女尸。

sentences.en: Then, detectives finally learned her name, Ada.
sentences.zh: 后来，侦探们终于知道了她的名字叫阿达。

sentences.en: But, identifying her only made this bizarre murder even more perplexing.
sentences.zh: 但是，确认她的身份反而让这起离奇的谋杀案更加扑朔迷离。

sentences.en: Ada is the new series from Casefile Presents, available now wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 《阿达》是 Casefile Presents 推出的全新系列，现已在各大播客平台上线。

sentences.en: 7.45 on the morning of Tuesday, August 16, 1988, 23-year-old Andrea Blecker was preparing to start her day in the west German town of Gladbeck.
sentences.zh: 1988年8月16日星期二上午7点45分，23岁的安德里亚·布莱克尔正准备在西德小镇格拉德贝克开始她的一天。

sentences.en: She worked as a customer service representative at a branch of the Deutsche Bank, which was housed in a rectangular, two-storey, brown brick building near the town centre.
sentences.zh: 她在德意志银行的一家分行担任客户服务代表，该分行位于镇中心附近一栋长方形的两层棕色砖砌建筑内。

sentences.en: Gladbeck sat in the western state of North Rhine, Westphalia, and had become a popular coal mining centre in the previous century.
sentences.zh: 格拉德贝克地处西部的北莱茵-威斯特法伦州，在过去的一个世纪里，它已经成为了一个热门的煤矿中心。

sentences.en: By the mid-1960s, that industry was on the decline, and the town had been battling high unemployment levels ever since.
sentences.zh: 到了20世纪60年代中期，该行业开始走下坡路，自那以后，该镇一直在与高失业率作斗争。

sentences.en: As she approached the bank, Andrea greeted a 34-year-old colleague who worked as a teller and was also making his way towards the building.
sentences.zh: 当安德里亚走近银行时，她向一位34岁的同事打了招呼，这位同事是一名出纳员，当时也正朝着大楼走去。

sentences.en: Just as the two of them reached the bank's glass doors, two masked men appeared out of nowhere.
sentences.zh: 正当两人走到银行的玻璃门前时，两个蒙面男子凭空出现。

sentences.en: Both were carrying revolvers.
sentences.zh: 两人都带着左轮手枪。

sentences.en: The men forced both bank employees into the building at gunpoint and threatened to shoot them.
sentences.zh: 这两人用枪指着两名银行员工，强迫他们进入大楼并威胁要开枪打死他们。

sentences.en: Inside, the bank was quiet and empty.
sentences.zh: 银行内部安静而空旷。

sentences.en: It hadn't opened yet, and there was no one else around.
sentences.zh: 当时还没开门，周围也没有其他人。

sentences.en: The gunman made it clear that this was an armed robbery and demanded a large sum of money.
sentences.zh: 持枪歹徒明确表示这是一起武装抢劫，并索要巨额资金。

sentences.en: Having been trained to handle this exact situation, the two clerks provided them with 120,000 German marks.
sentences.zh: 经过专门培训以应对这种突发情况，两名职员向他们提供了12万德国马克。

sentences.en: The hold-up was going perfectly for the robbers.
sentences.zh: 这场抢劫对劫匪来说进行得非常顺利。

sentences.en: They had their money, and the early hour made it likely that they'd escape quickly and without detection.
sentences.zh: 他们已经拿到了钱，而且由于时间尚早，很有可能迅速逃脱且不被发现。

sentences.en: But outside, a witness had spotted the crime in progress and called the police.
sentences.zh: 但在外面，一名目击者发现了正在进行的犯罪并报警了。

sentences.en: By 8.04am, officers had been dispatched to the scene and were lying in wait.
sentences.zh: 到上午8点04分，警察已被派往现场并埋伏起来。

sentences.en: As the two offenders made their way to the bank's front doors with their stolen loot, they spotted the police car parked nearby.
sentences.zh: 当两名罪犯带着偷来的赃物走向银行正门时，他们发现了停在附近的警车。

sentences.en: Hastily, the two men retreated back inside.
sentences.zh: 这两个人匆忙退回了室内。

sentences.en: They needed a new plan to secure their exit without getting arrested.
sentences.zh: 他们需要一个新计划，以确保在不被捕的情况下逃离。

sentences.en: They decided to take the two bank employees hostage.
sentences.zh: 他们决定劫持两名银行员工作为人质。

sentences.en: Robbing a bank had been an impromptu plan for the two men who were now hunkered down inside the Deutsche Bank.
sentences.zh: 对于此时正龟缩在德意志银行内部的两名男子来说，抢劫银行原本是个临时起意的计划。

sentences.en: The leader of the pair was a notorious local criminal named Hans-Jürgen Rosner.
sentences.zh: 两人中的首领是一个当地声名狼藉的罪犯，名叫汉斯-于尔根·罗斯纳。

sentences.en: He'd had his first brush with the law at the age of 14 and had a reputation for violent behaviour and a domineering personality.
sentences.zh: 他在14岁时就第一次触犯法律，以暴力行为和专横的性格而闻名。

sentences.en: After being convicted of robbery and assault, he'd spent 11 years in prison.
sentences.zh: 在因抢劫和袭击罪被定罪后，他在监狱里度过了11年。

sentences.en: During his incarceration, he stabbed a guard in the neck and had a couple more years added to his sentence.
sentences.zh: 服刑期间，他刺伤了一名狱警的脖子，刑期又被加了几年。

sentences.en: Eventually, he was released on parole, but had disappeared after going on the run.
sentences.zh: 最终他获得假释出狱，但在潜逃后销声匿迹。

sentences.en: Local law enforcement had been keeping an eye out for him ever since, to no avail.
sentences.zh: 自那以后，当地执法部门一直在寻找他的踪迹，但劳而无功。

sentences.en: Rosner was now 31 years old, with a scruffy beard and messy brown hair that was longer in the back but receding at the front.
sentences.zh: 罗斯纳当时31岁，留着邋遢的胡子和凌乱的棕色头发，脑后较长而发际线后移。

sentences.en: A yellow tank top exposed his heavily tattooed arms and he wore baggy blue jeans.
sentences.zh: 一件黄色背心露出了他布满纹身的双臂，他穿着一条肥大的蓝色牛仔裤。

sentences.en: He'd spent the previous night drinking with his accomplice, 32-year-old Dieter Dagowski.
sentences.zh: 前一天晚上，他一直在和同伙、32岁的迪特尔·达戈夫斯基一起喝酒。

sentences.en: The two men had met at school and were lifelong friends.
sentences.zh: 这两个男人在学校相识，是一辈子的朋友。

sentences.en: Dagowski had a quieter, more nervous personality, but a similarly substantial rap sheet.
sentences.zh: 达戈夫斯基性格更安静、更敏感，但同样有着厚厚的前科档案。

sentences.en: Like Rosner, he had receding brown hair, a beard and numerous tattoos, though his were concealed by a long-sleeved checked shirt.
sentences.zh: 和罗斯纳一样，他有着后退的棕色头发、胡须和无数纹身，不过他的纹身被一件长袖格子衬衫遮住了。

sentences.en: At 6 that morning, at the end of their all-night drinking session, the two friends had suddenly decided to try their luck at robbing a bank.
sentences.zh: 那天早上6点，在他们通宵喝酒狂欢结束后，这两个朋友突然决定碰碰运气去抢劫一家银行。

sentences.en: They'd made their way into town on a moped and waited until they spotted the two Deutsche
sentences.zh: 他们骑着一辆轻便摩托车来到镇上，一直等到发现那两名德意志

sentences.en: Bank employees.
sentences.zh: 银行员工。

sentences.en: Then they struck.
sentences.zh: 然后他们动手了。

sentences.en: Now, caught off guard by the arrival of police, Rosner and Dagowski frantically concocted a back-up plan.
sentences.zh: 现在，由于警察的突然到来而措手不及，罗斯纳和达戈夫斯基慌忙炮制了一个备用计划。

sentences.en: They would let officers know they were holding people captive and negotiate a deal in exchange for their freedom.
sentences.zh: 他们要让警察知道他们扣押了人质，并通过谈判换取他们的自由。

sentences.en: The men made contact with the police via the bank's telephone and informed them that they had guns and two hostages.
sentences.zh: 这两人通过银行的电话与警方取得联系，并告知对方他们有枪和两名人质。

sentences.en: Their victims would only be freed if police supplied a BMW getaway car and an additional
sentences.zh: 只有当警方提供一辆宝马逃跑车辆以及额外的

sentences.en: 300,000 German marks in small denominations.
sentences.zh: 30万德国马克零钱时，他们的受害者才会被释放。

sentences.en: To prove that they had weapons and should be considered dangerous, they fired their revolver through the bank's windows, shattering the glass.
sentences.zh: 为了证明他们有武器并且应当被视为危险人物，他们用左轮手枪朝银行窗户开枪，将玻璃击碎。

sentences.en: To prevent officers storming the building and thwarting their plan, Rosner and Dagowski forced their two hostages into the bank's bulletproof cash office, then followed them in.
sentences.zh: 为了防止警察冲进大楼破坏他们的计划，罗斯纳和达戈夫斯基强行将两名人质推进了银行防弹的现金办公室，然后跟了进去。

sentences.en: The police responded by bringing in a psychologist to call the bank and try to talk the men into revealing their identities.
sentences.zh: 警方做出的反应是请来一名心理专家给银行打电话，试图说服这两人透露他们的身份。

sentences.en: Rosner and Dagowski caught on to the ploy and refused to speak to the police any further.
sentences.zh: 罗斯纳和达戈夫斯基识破了这个花招，拒绝再与警方对话。

sentences.en: Instead, they demanded to speak to the bank's director and ordered that he organise the car and ransom money himself.
sentences.zh: 相反，他们要求与银行行长通话，并命令他亲自安排车辆和赎金。

sentences.en: Despite the robbers' refusal to name themselves, police were able to ID Hans-Jergen Rosner and deduced correctly that his accomplice was his long-time friend, Dieter Dagowski.
sentences.zh: 尽管劫匪拒绝说出自己的名字，警方还是查出了汉斯-于尔根·罗斯纳的身份，并正确推断出他的同伙是他多年的好友迪特尔·达戈夫斯基。

sentences.en: Mindful that both men were known for being volatile and dangerous, they decided their best course of action was to go along with their demands.
sentences.zh: 考虑到这两人都以反复无常和危险著称，他们认为最好的应对方式就是顺从他们的要求。

sentences.en: It took them a while to organise the cash.
sentences.zh: 他们花了一段时间才筹集好现金。

sentences.en: Before handing it over, police treated the banknotes with a solution that would leave traces on whoever handled it.
sentences.zh: 在交出钞票之前，警方用一种溶液处理了这些纸币，这种溶液会在任何经手之人身上留下痕迹。

sentences.en: That way, they'd have evidence pointing to the culprits when they managed to arrest them.
sentences.zh: 这样一来，当他们设法逮捕嫌疑人时，就会有指向罪犯的证据。

sentences.en: The process was a lengthy one, adding to the high stress of the urgent situation.
sentences.zh: 这个过程很漫长，加剧了紧迫局势下的高度紧张。

sentences.en: While police scrambled to get the funds ready, the men continued to call the bank's director, demanding to know why it hadn't arrived yet.
sentences.zh: 正当警方手忙脚乱地准备资金时，这两人继续打电话给银行行长，质问为什么钱还没到。

sentences.en: Tensions further increased when police realised they couldn't source a BMW as the robber's getaway car.
sentences.zh: 当警察意识到他们找不到一辆宝马作为劫匪的逃跑车辆时，紧张局势进一步加剧。

sentences.en: The only vehicles available were Audi's.
sentences.zh: 唯一能找到的车是奥迪。

sentences.en: Roesner and Dagowski grew increasingly anxious as they waited, and the police became nervous that they might lash out against their hostages.
sentences.zh: 罗斯纳和达戈夫斯基在等待时越来越焦虑，警察也开始担心他们会对人质下毒手。

sentences.en: Time continued to pass as law enforcement struggled to meet the robber's demands.
sentences.zh: 在执法部门艰难满足劫匪要求的同时，时间一分一秒地过去。

sentences.en: By 2pm, the hostages had been holed up inside the bank with their captors for more than six hours.
sentences.zh: 到了下午2点，人质已经和绑匪一起被困在银行里超过六个小时了。

sentences.en: By now, the press had caught wind of the story.
sentences.zh: 此时，媒体已经嗅到了这个新闻。

sentences.en: Word had filtered out that there was an ongoing standoff between two armed robbers and the police at the Gladbeck Deutsche Bank.
sentences.zh: 有消息传出，格拉德贝克德意志银行内正发生着两名持枪劫匪与警方之间的对峙。

sentences.en: The journalists didn't know the identity of the criminals and scrambled desperately for a scoop.
sentences.zh: 记者们并不知道罪犯的身份，正拼命抢夺独家新闻。

sentences.en: It was quickly discovered that the police hadn't blocked the bank's phone number, so anyone could dial in.
sentences.zh: 人们很快发现警方并没有封锁银行的电话号码，因此任何人都可以拨打进去。

sentences.en: A journalist phoned, and his call was met by a male voice.
sentences.zh: 一名记者打了个电话，接听电话的是一个男人的声音。

sentences.en: When the journalist asked who he was speaking to, the man on the other end of the line replied,
sentences.zh: 当记者问他在和谁说话时，电话那头的人回答说：

sentences.en: The bank robber.
sentences.zh: 银行劫匪。

sentences.en: When asked if they wanted anything other than the money and the car, the robber explained that they also wanted two sets of handcuffs.
sentences.zh: 当被问及除了钱和车之外是否还想要别的东西时，劫匪解释说他们还想要两副手铐。

sentences.en: Realising that this likely meant the two men had no intention of freeing the bank clerks, the journalist asked,
sentences.zh: 意识到这很可能意味着这两个人根本不打算释放银行职员，记者问道：

sentences.en: What do you need handcuffs for?
sentences.zh: 你要手铐干什么？

sentences.en: That means you are not planning to let the hostages go as soon as the demands are fulfilled.
sentences.zh: 这说明你们并不打算在满足要求后就释放人质。

sentences.en: The robber replied,
sentences.zh: 劫匪回答说：

sentences.en: Not initially.
sentences.zh: 一开始没打算。

sentences.en: We want to take them with us.
sentences.zh: 我们想把他们一起带走。

sentences.en: When asked where they planned to go, the robber responded sarcastically,
sentences.zh: 当被问及他们打算去哪里时，劫匪讽刺地回应道：

sentences.en: I'm not going to tell you.
sentences.zh: 我才不告诉你呢。

sentences.en: The journalist warned that they'd be followed wherever they went.
sentences.zh: 记者警告说，无论他们去哪都会被追踪。

sentences.en: The robber replied,
sentences.zh: 劫匪回答：

sentences.en: Conversation is over.
sentences.zh: 对话结束。

sentences.en: Then abruptly hung up.
sentences.zh: 随后便粗暴地挂断了电话。

sentences.en: A radio station was also able to get through to the bank's phone and conducted an impromptu on-air interview with the robbers.
sentences.zh: 一家广播电台也打通了银行的电话，并对劫匪进行了一场即兴的现场连线采访。

sentences.en: One of them stated,
sentences.zh: 其中一人表示：

sentences.en: From here on, I only want to speak through the media.
sentences.zh: 从现在开始，我只想通过媒体对话。

sentences.en: Finally, the money was ready.
sentences.zh: 最后，赎金准备好了。

sentences.en: It had been wrapped up in three plastic bundles.
sentences.zh: 它们被包裹在三个塑料捆里。

sentences.en: A police officer prepared to deliver it.
sentences.zh: 一名警官准备去送钱。

sentences.en: He stripped off his clothes and wore nothing but swimming shorts to prove he was unarmed.
sentences.zh: 他脱光了衣服，只穿一条游泳裤，以证明自己没有武器。

sentences.en: Carrying only the bundle of cash, he moved towards the bank.
sentences.zh: 他只带着这捆现金，向银行走去。

sentences.en: He placed the ransom money by the front entrance.
sentences.zh: 他把赎金放在了正门旁边。

sentences.en: The robbers forced the male hostage to collect the parcel.
sentences.zh: 劫匪强迫男名人质去取包裹。

sentences.en: Wearing a sling around his neck, the hostage lay sprawled on the floor of the bank's entrance and yanked the glass door open with one hand.
sentences.zh: 人质脖子上挂着吊带，瘫趴在银行入口的地上，单手拉开了玻璃门。

sentences.en: One by one, he picked up the parcels of money and threw them to his captors.
sentences.zh: 他一个接一个地拿起装钱的包裹，把它们扔给劫匪。

sentences.en: Then he closed the door and crawled back inside.
sentences.zh: 然后他关上门，又爬回了里面。

sentences.en: Multiple police officers continued to monitor the situation as journalists and television news crews looked on.
sentences.zh: 多名警察继续监控着局势，记者和电视新闻摄制组则在旁观望。

sentences.en: The hours continued to pass and there was still no sign of the getaway car.
sentences.zh: 时间一分一秒过去，逃跑的车依然不见踪影。

sentences.en: Then, at 8pm, a white, four-door Audi 100 sedan pulled up outside the bank.
sentences.zh: 接着，在晚上8点，一辆白色的四门奥迪100轿车停在了银行外面。

sentences.en: When it wasn't parked in the exact way that the robbers had requested,
sentences.zh: 由于它停放的位置与劫匪要求的并不完全一致，

sentences.en: Rosner demanded that it be moved closer to the building.
sentences.zh: 罗斯纳要求将车挪到离大楼更近的地方。

sentences.en: Then he, Dagowski, and the two bank employees emerged from the bank and filed into the car.
sentences.zh: 随后，他、达戈夫斯基以及两名银行员工从银行出来，依次坐进了车里。

sentences.en: The intensity of the situation had captured the nation.
sentences.zh: 紧张的局势吸引了全国的目光。

sentences.en: Cameramen filmed every moment as the police officers looked on.
sentences.zh: 在警察的注视下，摄影师记录下了每一个瞬间。

sentences.en: By now, officers from one of the state's tactical police units, known as the SE car, had arrived at the scene.
sentences.zh: 此时，州警察的一支战术分队（被称为SE突击车队）的警员已经抵达现场。

sentences.en: With Rosner behind the wheel, the car pulled away at 9.45pm and drove off into the dark night.
sentences.zh: 在罗斯纳的驾驶下，汽车于晚上9点45分启动，驶入漆黑的夜色中。

sentences.en: The police officers had promised they wouldn't follow, but they immediately gave chase.
sentences.zh: 警察虽然答应过不进行跟踪，但他们立刻展开了追击。

sentences.en: Unbeknown to the bank robbers, a GPS tracking unit had been installed on the Audi, so SE car officers were able to monitor their movements.
sentences.zh: 劫匪们并不知道，奥迪车上安装了一个GPS追踪器，因此SE车队的警员能够监控他们的行踪。

sentences.en: Their plan was to follow inconspicuously, hoping that the perpetrators would release their two hostages along the way.
sentences.zh: 他们的计划是进行隐蔽跟踪，希望罪犯能在半路释放两名人质。

sentences.en: Once they were freed, the police officers could run down the felons more safely.
sentences.zh: 一旦他们恢复自由，警员们就能更安全地追捕重罪犯。

sentences.en: They weren't the only ones in hot pursuit.
sentences.zh: 他们并不是唯一紧追不舍的人。

sentences.en: Members of the press received tip-offs from their contacts in the police force and also began chasing after the getaway car in earneSt.
sentences.zh: 新闻记者从警方的内线那里得到了消息，也开始全力追赶逃亡车辆。

sentences.en: They were always a step or so behind, often arriving at a location where the car had last been seen just after it departed.
sentences.zh: 他们总是慢了一步左右，通常是在汽车刚离开后才到达最后一个目击地点。

sentences.en: Wolfgang Scherning, the Deutsche Bank's director, was worried.
sentences.zh: 德意志银行董事沃尔夫冈·舍尔宁开始担忧起来。

sentences.en: Ever since the robbers had decided they no longer wanted to negotiate with police, he had been acting as their mediator and had spoken to Rosner on the phone numerous times.
sentences.zh: 自从劫匪决定不再与警方谈判以来，他一直担任他们的调解人，并多次与罗斯纳通电话。

sentences.en: After receiving the ransom money, Rosner had assured Wolfgang they would be releasing his two employees as soon as it was safe to do so.
sentences.zh: 在收到赎金后，罗斯纳向沃尔夫冈保证，一旦安全，他们就会释放他的两名员工。

sentences.en: But now Wolfgang feared that as long as the robbers were being followed, they would refuse to let the hostages go.
sentences.zh: 但现在沃尔夫冈担心，只要劫匪被跟踪，他们就会拒绝释放人质。

sentences.en: Wolfgang begged the police to give up their chase, but they refused, assuring him they were following from a safe distance and there was no way that their targets had any idea.
sentences.zh: 沃尔夫冈恳求警方放弃追捕，但遭到拒绝，警方保证他们是在安全距离外跟踪，目标绝对不可能察觉。

sentences.en: Then at one stage, the bank robbers pulled into a service station.
sentences.zh: 后来在某个阶段，银行劫匪将车开进了一家加油站。

sentences.en: The police were close behind.
sentences.zh: 警察紧随其后。

sentences.en: To their surprise, Rosner walked straight up to an officer and stole his gun.
sentences.zh: 令他们惊讶的是，罗斯纳径直走向一名警察并抢走了他的枪。

sentences.en: Now he and his accomplice had a total of three firearMs.
sentences.zh: 现在他和同伙总共有了三把枪。

sentences.en: After leaving the bank, Rosner and Dagowski weren't sure where to turn.
sentences.zh: 离开银行后，罗斯纳和达戈夫斯基不确定该去哪里。

sentences.en: They'd made a beeline for the autobahn, a highway system that spanned across the entire country, but they could see that they were being followed by police and the media.
sentences.zh: 他们径直开往贯穿全国的高速公路网，但他们能看出自己正被警察和媒体跟踪。

sentences.en: For a while, they drove around aimlessly with no destination in mind.
sentences.zh: 有一段时间，他们漫无目的地四处开车，心中没有目的地。

sentences.en: Suddenly, Rosner was struck with an idea.
sentences.zh: 突然，罗斯纳灵机一动。

sentences.en: He would stop by the home of his girlfriend, 34-year-old Marion Lerblick, and pick her up so she could accompany them.
sentences.zh: 他打算顺道去34岁女友马里昂·莱布利克的住所，接她一起同行。

sentences.en: After getting in the car, Lerblick suggested that they go to Bremen, a city 238 kilometres north-east of Gladbeck, where some of her relatives lived.
sentences.zh: 上车后，莱布利克建议他们去不来梅，那是格拉德贝克东北238公里的一座城市，她的一些亲戚住在那里。

sentences.en: It was a significant journey that could take up to three hours to complete.
sentences.zh: 这是一段漫长的旅程，最多可能需要三个小时才能完成。

sentences.en: Rosner and Dagowski agreed and got back on the autobahn.
sentences.zh: 罗斯纳和达戈夫斯基同意了，并重新上了高速公路。

sentences.en: As they drove, they turned on the car radio.
sentences.zh: 在开车时，他们打开了车载收音机。

sentences.en: Stations were providing news updates about their escape and police efforts to track them.
sentences.zh: 各大电台都在播报关于他们逃跑以及警方全力搜捕他们的最新新闻。

sentences.en: After a while, the group stopped at another service station so that everyone could get some food.
sentences.zh: 过了一会儿，这伙人在另一个服务区停了下来，好让大家买点吃的。

sentences.en: As Rosner, Dagowski and Lerblick sat at one table eating, the two hostages sat side by side at another.
sentences.zh: 正当罗斯纳、达戈夫斯基和勒布利克坐在一张桌子旁吃东西时，两名人质坐在另一张桌子旁。

sentences.en: Undercover officers watched from the very next table.
sentences.zh: 便衣警察就坐在隔壁桌监视着。

sentences.en: One at a time, Rosner and Dagowski got up and went to the bathroom.
sentences.zh: 罗斯纳和达戈夫斯基一个接一个地站起来去洗手间。

sentences.en: Unwilling to provoke the armed men, the police remained seated and made no attempt to follow them.
sentences.zh: 由于不愿激怒这些武装人员，警方按兵不动，没有试图跟着他们。

sentences.en: Eventually, the group got up, piled back into the white Audi and drove off once again.
sentences.zh: 最终，这伙人起身再次钻进白色奥迪车，扬长而去。

sentences.en: The police continued to follow the bank robbers as they made their way towards Bremen, but it was members of the media who managed to stay right on their tail.
sentences.zh: 警方继续尾随这群劫匪驶向不莱梅，但真正能死死咬住他们不放的却是媒体记者。

sentences.en: After making several stops along the way, the robbers and their hostages arrived at their destination on the morning of Wednesday August 17.
sentences.zh: 在沿途多次停留后，劫匪和他们的人质于8月17日星期三上午抵达了目的地。

sentences.en: Still armed, Rosner and his girlfriend Marian Lerblick went shopping, while Dagowski stayed with the hostages.
sentences.zh: 罗斯纳和他的女友玛丽安·勒布利克依然带着武器去购物，而达戈夫斯基则留在原地看着人质。

sentences.en: Rosner purchased a suit and unsuccessfully tried to hire a car in an attempt to switch to a vehicle that law enforcement wouldn't recognise.
sentences.zh: 罗斯纳买了一套西装，并试图租一辆车以便换一辆执法部门认不出来的汽车，但没有成功。

sentences.en: Back at the car, Dagowski had consumed a mix of alcohol and pills and the combination caused him to doze off.
sentences.zh: 回到车上后，达戈夫斯基混着酒精和药片吞服了，这两种东西混在一起导致他打起了瞌睡。

sentences.en: 23-year-old hostage Andrea Blecker noticed that he'd left his gun on a partition between the seats.
sentences.zh: 23岁的人质安德烈娅·布莱克注意到他把枪留在了座椅之间的隔板上。

sentences.en: She and her colleague contemplated snatching the weapon while Dagowski slept, but were terrified of getting caught.
sentences.zh: 她和同事曾考虑趁达戈夫斯基睡着时把武器夺过来，但又害怕被抓个正着。

sentences.en: They decided not to risk it.
sentences.zh: 她们决定不去冒这个险。

sentences.en: Rosner returned to the car after an hour and escorted Andrea to a nearby greengrocer.
sentences.zh: 一小时后，罗斯纳回到车上，带着安德烈娅去了附近的一家菜店。

sentences.en: He instructed her to call the police from the store's phone and relay a message on his behalf.
sentences.zh: 他指示她用店里的电话报警，并代他转达一条消息。

sentences.en: The press made no secret of the fact that they were following their every move.
sentences.zh: 媒体毫不掩饰他们在跟踪他们一举一动的事实。

sentences.en: A crowd of journalists, photographers and camera crews swarmed around the greengrocer as Andrea picked up the phone and did as she was told.
sentences.zh: 当安德烈拿起电话按吩咐行事时，一群记者、摄影师和摄像人员蜂拥围住了这家蔬菜水果店。

sentences.en: Speaking to a police officer, she complained about law enforcement following them,
sentences.zh: 在与一名警官通话时，她抱怨执法部门一直在跟踪他们，

sentences.en: saying that their unrelenting pursuit of the group was the reason she and her colleague were still being held hostage.
sentences.zh: 并称正是由于警方对他们穷追不舍，她和同事才至今仍被劫为人质。

sentences.en: Andrea added that they both trusted their abductors more than law enforcement and warned that if either of them were killed, the police would be to blame.
sentences.zh: 安德烈补充说，他们两个对绑架者的信任甚至超过了执法部门，并警告说如果他们两人有谁被杀，警方将难辞其咎。

sentences.en: Rosner then snatched the phone from Andrea and demanded to speak with the task force's top brass.
sentences.zh: 随后，罗斯纳从安德烈手中抢过电话，要求与专案组的高层对话。

sentences.en: The relevant officers weren't present at the time and Rosner's request was not met.
sentences.zh: 相关警官当时不在场，罗斯纳的要求未能得到满足。

sentences.en: Just as Rosner was attempting to reach out to them again, he spotted a nearby car that he suspected held undercover officers.
sentences.zh: 就在罗斯纳试图再次与他们取得联系时，他发现附近有一辆可疑汽车，怀疑里面坐着便衣警察。

sentences.en: He became enraged and impulsively grabbed one of the greengrocer's customers, taking them prisoner as well.
sentences.zh: 他勃然大怒，冲动之下抓住了蔬菜店的一名顾客，也将对方劫为人质。

sentences.en: He and Dagowski then marched their hostages across the road to a nearby bus stop.
sentences.zh: 随后，他和达戈夫斯基押着人质穿过马路，来到附近的一个公交车站。

sentences.en: News crews filmed them and their movements were broadcast live to viewers all over the country.
sentences.zh: 新闻摄制组拍摄了他们的画面，他们的动向被向全国各地的观众进行现场直播。

sentences.en: Police remained reluctant to intervene, worried that if they attempted to make an arrest, innocent people could end up being killed.
sentences.zh: 警方仍然不愿进行干预，担心如果他们试图实施抓捕，可能会导致无辜人员丧生。

sentences.en: By now it had been almost 36 hours since Rosner and Dagowski had set out to rob a bank.
sentences.zh: 此时，距离罗斯纳和达戈夫斯基出发去抢劫银行已经过去了将近36个小时。

sentences.en: The two men were sustaining themselves with amphetamines and pills.
sentences.zh: 这两个男人靠服用安非他命和药丸来维持体力。

sentences.en: They also drank beer constantly.
sentences.zh: 他们还不停地喝着啤酒。

sentences.en: They were growing increasingly desperate to escape and felt a faster getaway car was their only chance to elude those pursuing them.
sentences.zh: 他们急于逃脱的心情与日俱增，觉得一辆跑得更快的逃跑车辆是摆脱追捕者的唯一机会。

sentences.en: The two men decided they needed a bigger bargaining chip in order to negotiate with the authorities.
sentences.zh: 这两个男人决定，他们需要更大的筹码来与当局谈判。

sentences.en: Idling at the bus stop across the road from the greengrocers was a red public transit bus.
sentences.zh: 停在蔬菜店马路对面的公交车站里的是一辆红色的公共交通巴士。

sentences.en: Sitting inside was the driver and 25 passengers, ranging from children to the elderly.
sentences.zh: 车里坐着司机和25名乘客，年龄从小孩子到老人不等。

sentences.en: At approximately 7pm, Rosner and Dagowski climbed aboard with the two bank hostages and pointed their firearms at the passengers, announcing that they were hijacking the bus.
sentences.zh: 大约晚上7点，罗斯纳和达戈夫斯基带着两名银行人质登上了公交车，用枪指着乘客，宣布他们正在劫持公交车。

sentences.en: The people on board were confused as to what exactly was going on.
sentences.zh: 车上的人对到底发生了什么感到十分困惑。

sentences.en: Passenger Stephanie Hinzpeter thought that they must have been filming a crime show or a program where pranks were played on unsuspecting members of the public.
sentences.zh: 乘客斯蒂芬妮·欣茨佩特认为，他们一定是在拍摄犯罪剧，或者是一个对毫不知情的公众搞恶作剧的节目。

sentences.en: Rosner and Dagowski had ordered the bank hostages to sit in a pair of seats.
sentences.zh: 罗斯纳和达戈夫斯基命令银行人质坐在成对的座位上。

sentences.en: Behind them sat 18-year-old Enis Voitler and her friend Silke Bischoff.
sentences.zh: 在他们身后坐着18岁的埃尼斯·沃特勒和她的朋友西尔克·比施霍夫。

sentences.en: Enis was confused.
sentences.zh: 埃尼斯感到很困惑。

sentences.en: Like Stephanie, she wondered if the entire thing was part of a low-budget movie.
sentences.zh: 和斯蒂芬妮一样，她琢磨着整件事是不是某部低成本电影的一部分。

sentences.en: But when she took a closer look at the hostages sitting in front of her, she saw how distraught they looked.
sentences.zh: 但当她仔细端详坐在前面的那些人质时，她看到了他们脸上绝望的神情。

sentences.en: After that, she decided to stay quiet and lie low for her own protection.
sentences.zh: 在那之后，为了自身安全，她决定保持安静、低调行事。

sentences.en: Officers from Brayman's SE car unit were still reluctant to directly intervene.
sentences.zh: 布雷曼特别行动车队的警官们仍然不愿直接进行干预。

sentences.en: They'd been ordered to avoid any actions that could place the hostages in danger.
sentences.zh: 他们接到命令，要避免任何可能将人质置于危险之中的行动。

sentences.en: According to one responding officer, that… pretty much meant that we weren't able to do anything at all.
sentences.zh: 据一名出警的警官说，那……基本上意味着我们什么也做不了。

sentences.en: In a bizarre twist of fate, the unit had wanted to practice responding to a hostage situation on a bus several weeks earlier.
sentences.zh: 戏剧性的是，就在几个星期前，该部队曾想要进行一次应对公交车人质事件的演练。

sentences.en: Unfortunately, the drill hadn't gone ahead due to being too expensive to coordinate.
sentences.zh: 不幸的是，由于协调成本太高，演练最终未能进行。

sentences.en: While the police stood back and kept a close eye on things, the many journalists who were present descended on the bus stop.
sentences.zh: 在警方退后并密切注视局势的同时，在场的众多记者纷纷涌向公交车站。

sentences.en: For them, the chance to cover a crime in real time with no interference from police was an incredible once-in-a-lifetime opportunity.
sentences.zh: 对他们来说，这是一个千载难逢的大好机会，可以毫无警方干扰地实时报道一起犯罪事件。

sentences.en: Dagowski stayed on the bus, but Rosner disembarked, seeming to relish the media attention.
sentences.zh: 达戈夫斯基留在了车上，但罗斯纳下了车，似乎很享受媒体的关注。

sentences.en: Journalists thrust microphones and cameras at his face.
sentences.zh: 记者们将麦克风和摄像机怼到他的脸前。

sentences.en: The startling update was broadcast to viewers at home.
sentences.zh: 这一令人震惊的最新进展通过电视播报给了家中的观众。

sentences.en: Camera crews and photographers boarded the bus to get close-up angles of the situation on board.
sentences.zh: 摄像团队和摄影师登上巴士，试图拍摄车内情况的特写镜头。

sentences.en: Passengers watched on as the media documented their ordeal, but made no attempt to assist them.
sentences.zh: 乘客们眼睁睁看着媒体记录他们的苦难，却没有任何人施以援手。

sentences.en: Dagowski posed for the cameras with a smirk on his face as he casually held his pistol in one hand.
sentences.zh: 达戈夫斯基面带假笑向镜头摆出姿势，单手随意地握着手枪。

sentences.en: Rosner's girlfriend, Marion Leerblick, was carrying the third firearm.
sentences.zh: 罗斯纳的女友玛丽昂·莱尔布利克带着第三把枪。

sentences.en: In their frenzy to be the first to break the story, some journalists mistakenly claimed that a police officer was among the now 28 hostages.
sentences.zh: 在争先恐后抢发独家新闻的狂热中，一些记者错误地宣称，目前多达28名人质中包括一名警员。

sentences.en: Bremen's mayor, Klaus Wiedermeister, had arrived at the increasingly chaotic scene and appeared on camera.
sentences.zh: 不来梅市长克劳斯·维德迈斯特已经抵达日益混乱的现场，并在镜头前亮相。

sentences.en: He criticised the media's coverage of the dangerous situation, stating,
sentences.zh: 他批评媒体对这一危险局势的报道，并表示：

sentences.en: I think you've crossed a line.
sentences.zh: 我认为你们已经越界了。

sentences.en: As soon as his interview concluded, reporters returned their attention to the bank robbers.
sentences.zh: 他的采访刚一结束，记者们便将注意力重新转向了银行劫匪。

sentences.en: Rosner gave an impromptu press conference just outside the bus.
sentences.zh: 罗斯纳在巴士外即兴举行了一场新闻发布会。

sentences.en: He held a pistol in his right hand as he spoke to reporters.
sentences.zh: 他在对记者说话时，右手一直握着一把手枪。

sentences.en: When asked why he had decided to rob the bank in the first place, he simply replied,
sentences.zh: 当被问及当初为何决定抢劫银行时，他只是简单地回答：

sentences.en: I don't have any morals.
sentences.zh: 我没有任何道德。

sentences.en: There is no other work for me.
sentences.zh: 我找不到别的工作。

sentences.en: I want to live my life.
sentences.zh: 我想过我的人生。

sentences.en: His face was blank as he said,
sentences.zh: 他面无表情地说道：

sentences.en: My buddy is very dangerous.
sentences.zh: 我的同伴非常危险。

sentences.en: This will be the end.
sentences.zh: 这将是结局。

sentences.en: I already sat 13 years in prison.
sentences.zh: 我已经坐了13年牢了。

sentences.en: I don't give a shit for my whole life.
sentences.zh: 我根本不在乎我这辈子。

sentences.en: Then he mimed suicide by placing the nozzle of the gun in his mouth.
sentences.zh: 随后，他把枪口塞进嘴里，做出了开枪自杀的假动作。

sentences.en: Casefile will be back shortly.
sentences.zh: 《档案》节目稍后回归。

sentences.en: Thank you for supporting us by listening to this episode's sponsors.
sentences.zh: 感谢您收听本期节目的赞助商广告以支持我们。

sentences.en: Thank you for listening to this episode's ads.
sentences.zh: 感谢您收听本期节目的广告。

sentences.en: By supporting our sponsors, you support Casefile to continue to deliver quality content.
sentences.zh: 通过支持我们的赞助商，您也在支持《档案》继续为您带来优质内容。

sentences.en: About 15 minutes after the bus was hijacked, some of the passengers had had enough.
sentences.zh: 在大巴被劫持大约15分钟后，一些乘客再也忍受不了了。

sentences.en: They weren't sure what was happening, but the presence of the media gave the situation a surreal feel.
sentences.zh: 他们不确定发生了什么，但媒体的出现让整个局势有一种超现实的感觉。

sentences.en: There was little sense of fear, even though they'd been threatened with guns.
sentences.zh: 尽管他们曾遭到枪支威胁，但并没有多少恐惧感。

sentences.en: Four elderly passengers and one child disembarked the vehicle, with one woman pausing to ask some journalists if she was allowed to do so.
sentences.zh: 四名老年乘客和一个孩子走下了车，其中一位女士甚至停下来问记者她是否可以这样做。

sentences.en: They gave her permission, and she continued on her way.
sentences.zh: 记者允许了，于是她继续往前走。

sentences.en: Neither Rosner nor Dagowski tried to stop any of them from leaving.
sentences.zh: 罗斯纳和达戈夫斯基都没有试图阻止任何人离开。

sentences.en: One of the elderly passengers later told the press,
sentences.zh: 其中一位老年乘客后来对记者说：

sentences.en: I simply stood up.
sentences.zh: 我只是站了起来。

sentences.en: No one stopped me.
sentences.zh: 没有人阻止我。

sentences.en: Live footage of the ongoing crisis was streamed throughout evening news prograMs. The entire country was captivated.
sentences.zh: 持续中的危机现场直播通过晚间新闻节目传遍各地，全国上下都为之吸引。

sentences.en: A press photographer named Peter Meyer took on the role of messenger, acting as a go-between between the bank robbers and the police.
sentences.zh: 一名名叫彼得·迈尔的摄影记者扮演了信使的角色，在劫匪和警察之间充当中间人。

sentences.en: Rosner was now asking for a faster car, free from tracking devices, another 300,000 to 400,000 marks, an extra set of handcuffs, and a police officer whose hands were bound.
sentences.zh: 罗斯纳现在要求一辆速度更快、没有追踪器的汽车，再要30万到40万马克，一副新手铐，以及一名双手被绑的警察。

sentences.en: In exchange for these things, he and Dagowski would release all of the hostages on the bus.
sentences.zh: 作为交换，他和达戈夫斯基将释放公交车上的所有人质。

sentences.en: If their demands were not met,
sentences.zh: 如果他们的要求得不到满足，

sentences.en: Rosner said they would blow up the bus.
sentences.zh: 罗斯纳称他们就会炸毁这辆公交车。

sentences.en: The photographer shared these demands with the press, before passing them on to police.
sentences.zh: 这名摄影师在将这些要求转交给警方之前，先向媒体透露了这些要求。

sentences.en: Officers watched from a safe distance.
sentences.zh: 警官们在安全距离外观察着。

sentences.en: They were reluctant to provide one of their own as a hostage, given the perpetrator's obvious dislike of law enforcement.
sentences.zh: 考虑到罪犯对执法部门的明显厌恶，他们很不愿让自己的同事去当人质。

sentences.en: By this time, snipers had been dispatched to the scene and were hiding nearby with a perfect view of the bus stop.
sentences.zh: 此时，狙击手已被派往现场，并隐蔽在附近，完美地监视着公交车站。

sentences.en: They were just waiting for the right moment to strike, and the permission to do so.
sentences.zh: 他们只是在等待合适的时机动手，以及行动的批准。

sentences.en: It was never granted.
sentences.zh: 这个批准始终没有下达。

sentences.en: Although the bank robbers were often in their sights while the hostages remained safely on the bus, a local law prevented so-called rescue shooting.
sentences.zh: 尽管银行劫匪经常处于他们的视线范围内，人质也安全地呆在车上，但当地的一项法律禁止实施所谓的救援射击。

sentences.en: Rosner continued chatting with the media, who occasionally lit cigarettes for him.
sentences.zh: 罗斯纳继续与媒体闲聊，记者偶尔为他点烟。

sentences.en: He appeared relaxed and seemed to enjoy his sudden celebrity status.
sentences.zh: 他显得很放松，似乎很享受自己突然成名的状态。

sentences.en: At one stage, he left his pistol lying across his lap as he spoke to reporters.
sentences.zh: 有一次，他在与记者交谈时，把手枪随意放在膝盖上。

sentences.en: But eventually, he got tired of relaying his demands via a messenger and demanded that the police speak to him directly.
sentences.zh: 但最终，他厌倦了通过信使转达要求，并要求警方直接与他对话。

sentences.en: Peter Meyer begged some officers to do so, but they refused.
sentences.zh: 彼得·迈尔恳求几名警察这么做，但他们拒绝了。

sentences.en: Instead, they gave him a radio that Rosner could use to speak to them.
sentences.zh: 相反，他们给了他一台对讲机，罗斯纳可以用它与他们通话。

sentences.en: Rosner tried to use the radio, but it didn't work.
sentences.zh: 罗斯纳试图使用这台对讲机，但它坏了。

sentences.en: He became infuriated and his rage only increased when he spotted what he thought was a police officer in the window of a nearby building.
sentences.zh: 他勃然大怒，当他发现附近一栋建筑的窗户里好像有一个警察时，他的怒火更是火上浇油。

sentences.en: Rosner stormed onto the bus and grabbed one of the hostages, 18-year-old Silke Bischoff.
sentences.zh: 罗斯纳冲上公交车，抓住了其中一名人质，18岁的西尔克·比施霍夫。

sentences.en: Silke was a court stenographer and a trainee at a law firm situated in Bremen.
sentences.zh: 西尔克是一名法庭速记员，也是不来梅一家律师事务所的实习生。

sentences.en: She'd finished work an hour early that day, but had waited for her friend and colleague Ines Voigtler to finish so they could catch the bus home together.
sentences.zh: 那天她比平时早下一个小时下班，但为了等她的朋友兼同事伊内斯·福伊特勒下班，好一起坐公交车回家，便多等了一会儿。

sentences.en: Rosner pulled Silke off the bus, then dragged her in front of the police and media as he pressed his gun to her head and shouted,
sentences.zh: 罗斯纳把西尔克拉下公交车，然后把她拖到警察和媒体面前，将枪顶在她的头上大喊道：

sentences.en: You motherfucker!
sentences.zh: 你这杂种！

sentences.en: Fuck off, or it is going to fire up in here!
sentences.zh: 滚开，否则这里就要开火了！

sentences.en: Rosner then shot in the direction of the window and added,
sentences.zh: 罗斯纳随后朝着窗户的方向开了一枪，并补充道：

sentences.en: This is the last warning.
sentences.zh: 这是最后的警告。

sentences.en: The next one is going to fly out of the bus.
sentences.zh: 下一颗子弹就要飞出公交车了。

sentences.en: The commotion drew more onlookers to the scene.
sentences.zh: 这场骚乱吸引了更多的旁观者来到现场。

sentences.en: By now, daylight was fading and it was growing dark.
sentences.zh: 此时，天色渐暗，夜幕降临。

sentences.en: Rosner continued trying to use the police radio, but it had very poor reception.
sentences.zh: 罗斯纳继续试图使用警用对讲机，但信号非常差。

sentences.en: The demands he barked into it were going ignored.
sentences.zh: 他对着对讲机大吼的要求被无视了。

sentences.en: Frustrated by the lack of response from police,
sentences.zh: 由于警方迟迟没有回应，罗斯纳感到十分沮丧，

sentences.en: Rosner grabbed another hostage.
sentences.zh: 于是他又抓了另一个人质。

sentences.en: This time he chose an eight-year-old girl named Tatiana DiGiorgi, who had been riding the bus with her 15-year-old brother, Emanuela.
sentences.zh: 这一次他选择了一个8岁的小女孩，名叫塔蒂亚娜·迪焦尔吉，她当时和15岁的哥哥埃马努埃拉一起坐这辆公交车。

sentences.en: Their family was Italian and had migrated to West Germany in the hopes of a better, more prosperous life.
sentences.zh: 他们的家庭是意大利人，为了追求更好、更富裕的生活，移民到了西德。

sentences.en: Rosner used Tatiana as a protective shield, holding the gun to her head as he screamed,
sentences.zh: 罗斯纳把塔蒂亚娜当成肉盾，把枪抵在她的头上尖叫道：

sentences.en: What is going on now, you motherfucker?
sentences.zh: 现在到底在搞什么鬼，你这个混蛋？

sentences.en: You cowardly pigs!
sentences.zh: 你们这群懦弱的猪！

sentences.en: The only other sound, aside from his voice, was the click of cameras as photographers snapped shots of the disturbing scene.
sentences.zh: 除了他的声音外，现场唯一的其他声音就是摄影师拍摄这幕令人不安的场景时发出的快门声。

sentences.en: News crews captured Tatiana standing there, dressed in a dark-coloured skirt, a striped long-sleeved top and a white headband in her long dark hair.
sentences.zh: 新闻摄制组拍下了塔蒂亚娜站在那里的画面，她穿着一条深色裙子，一件条纹长袖上衣，长长的黑发上戴着一个白色发箍。

sentences.en: She looked frightened as she clutched a red bag to her cheSt. Rosner handed the police radio to Peter Meyer and gave him a new message to pass on.
sentences.zh: 她看起来很害怕，紧紧把一个红色的包抱在胸前。罗斯纳把警用对讲机交给了彼得·迈尔，并让他转达一条新消息。

sentences.en: He wanted a new radio and would drive the bus around the block until it was ready.
sentences.zh: 他想要一个新的对讲机，并会开着公交车绕着街区兜圈子，直到新对讲机准备好。

sentences.en: Peter ran back to the police to update them.
sentences.zh: 彼得跑回警察那里向他们通报最新情况。

sentences.en: He explained that he'd tried to convince Rosner to leave the hostages and use his car instead, but he'd declined.
sentences.zh: 他解释说，他曾试图说服罗斯纳放下人质并改用他自己的车，但被拒绝了。

sentences.en: At 10pm, Rosner and Dagowski had finally had enough of waiting.
sentences.zh: 晚上10点，罗斯纳和达戈夫斯基终于等得不耐烦了。

sentences.en: They took command of the bus and it pulled away from the small shopping strip.
sentences.zh: 他们控制了公交车，车子驶离了那个小型购物街区。

sentences.en: An investigator later reflected, it was pretty much the turning point with no peaceful ending to hope for.
sentences.zh: 一位调查人员后来回忆说，这几乎是一个转折点，从此再也无法奢望和平结局了。

sentences.en: Peter Meyer decided to get in his car and follow them.
sentences.zh: 彼得·迈尔决定上车去追踪他们。

sentences.en: As he had a car phone, he dialed a number some officers had given him that were supposed to connect him with the case's operation controllers.
sentences.zh: 由于车上有车载电话，他拨打了几名警官给他留下的号码，据称该号码可以接通本案的行动指挥人员。

sentences.en: The call failed to go through.
sentences.zh: 电话没有打通。

sentences.en: Peter wasn't sure whether the police had made a mistake when giving him the number or if they'd deliberately provided the wrong one.
sentences.zh: 彼得不确定是警察给号码时出了错，还是他们故意给了一个错误的号码。

sentences.en: The bus steered back on the autobahn and began heading northeaSt. Tatiana de Georgie sat on the lap of her older brother, Emanuela.
sentences.zh: 公交车驶回高速公路，开始朝东北方向行驶。塔蒂亚娜·德·乔治坐在她哥哥埃马纽埃尔的腿上。

sentences.en: He did his best to keep her calm by whispering assurances, telling her, don't be scared, I'll protect you.
sentences.zh: 他尽力低声安慰她，让她保持冷静，告诉她别害怕，我会保护你的。

sentences.en: After travelling almost 40 kilometres, the bank robbers pulled over at a highway service station.
sentences.zh: 在行驶了将近40公里后，这伙银行劫匪把车停在了一个高速公路服务区。

sentences.en: Marion Lerblik needed to use the bathroom and Rosner and Dagowski decided it would be a good idea to also buy some food and alcohol.
sentences.zh: 玛丽昂·勒布利克需要去洗手间，罗斯纳和dagowski决定顺便买点食物和酒也是个好主意。

sentences.en: The journalists pursuing the vehicle quickly realised what was going on and stopped at the rest stop as well.
sentences.zh: 紧追不舍的记者们很快意识到发生了什么，也在这个休息站停了下来。

sentences.en: While Lerblik made her way to the bathroom,
sentences.zh: 正当勒布利克朝洗手间走去时，

sentences.en: Dagowski disembarked the bus for the first time since he and his accomplice had commandeered it.
sentences.zh: 达戈夫斯基走下了公交车，这是他和同伙劫持公交车以来的第一次。

sentences.en: To protect himself, he took hostage Silke Bischoff with him, holding a gun to her throat.
sentences.zh: 为了保护自己，他挟持了西尔克·比肖夫作为人质，用枪抵着她的喉咙。

sentences.en: If Silke feared for her life, she refused to show it.
sentences.zh: 如果西尔克对自己的生命感到害怕，她也表现得毫不在乎。

sentences.en: She remained stoic as reporters gathered around her and Dagowski and pointed microphones at her armed captor while peppering him with questions.
sentences.zh: 当记者们聚集在她和达戈夫斯基周围，把麦克风对准这个武装绑架者并连珠炮似地向他提问时，她依然镇定自若。

sentences.en: When one journalist asked if he was really willing to kill people, Dagowski simply replied,
sentences.zh: 当一名记者问他是否真的愿意杀人时，达戈夫斯基简短地回答说，

sentences.en: yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Silke was interviewed as well.
sentences.zh: 西尔克也接受了采访。

sentences.en: When a reporter asked how she felt, she responded,
sentences.zh: 当记者问她感觉如何时，她回答说，

sentences.en: actually pretty good considering the circumstances.
sentences.zh: 考虑到目前的情况，其实感觉还挺好的。

sentences.en: I don't really get it.
sentences.zh: 我其实有点搞不懂。

sentences.en: She couldn't imagine that
sentences.zh: 她无法想象

sentences.en: Dagowski would really shoot her, despite his constant threats.
sentences.zh: 尽管达戈夫斯基不断发出威胁，但他真的会开枪打死她。

sentences.en: They seemed empty and hollow.
sentences.zh: 那些威胁似乎都是空洞的。

sentences.en: He'd had his chance to harm others, but had opted to avoid bloodshed and, in some cases, let hostages go.
sentences.zh: 他曾有机会伤害其他人，但他选择避免流血，在某些情况下还释放了人质。

sentences.en: A journalist even interviewed press photographer Peter Meyer, who had inadvertently become a part of the story since acting as the robber's messenger.
sentences.zh: 一名记者甚至采访了摄影记者彼得·迈尔，由于充当了劫匪的信使，他无意中成了这个故事的一部分。

sentences.en: Peter was concerned that police were not handling the situation well.
sentences.zh: 彼得担心警方并没有处理好这一局面。

sentences.en: First, they'd refused to send an officer in to communicate with the two culprits.
sentences.zh: 首先，他们拒绝派一名警官进去与这两个罪犯沟通。

sentences.en: Then they'd provided radios that didn't work well, and a phone number that failed to connect.
sentences.zh: 随后他们提供的对讲机根本不好用，给的电话号码也打不通。

sentences.en: I really don't know what the police are thinking, Peter worried aloud.
sentences.zh: 彼得大声担忧道：“我真不知道警察在想什么。”

sentences.en: Peter was also anxious about the two bank employees who'd been held captive since the previous morning, more than 38 hours earlier.
sentences.zh: 彼得还对自前一天早上（也就是38个多小时前）以来一直被扣为人质的两名银行员工感到焦虑。

sentences.en: The length of their ordeal meant they were battling stress and exhaustion.
sentences.zh: 他们经历的折磨意味着他们正在与压力和精疲力竭作斗争。

sentences.en: He convinced Rosner and Dagowski to release them in exchange for him and a colleague taking their place.
sentences.zh: 他说服了罗斯纳和达戈夫斯基释放他们，条件是他和一名同事取代他们的位置。

sentences.en: Both employees looked extremely relieved as they were freed from the bus and permitted to leave.
sentences.zh: 当两名员工从公交车上被释放并被允许离开时，他们看起来都如释重负。

sentences.en: Andrea Blecker later told the media that she'd kept hoping she would be let go, but had resigned herself to the possibility of being shot instead.
sentences.zh: 安德烈娅·布莱克后来告诉媒体，她一直希望自己能被放走，但也做好了可能被枪杀的心理准备。

sentences.en: Journalists weren't the only observers who'd gathered at the scene.
sentences.zh: 聚集在现场的观察者不仅仅是记者。

sentences.en: Some police officers had arrived too and were debating whether or not to finally act.
sentences.zh: 一些警员也赶到了现场，正在讨论是否最终采取行动。

sentences.en: Hans-Jürgen Rosner's girlfriend, Marianne Lerblik, had walked from the bus to a public restroom.
sentences.zh: 汉斯-于尔根·罗斯纳的女友玛丽安娜·莱尔布利克从公交车走向了一个公共厕所。

sentences.en: She'd taken a female hostage with her and had made sure to carry her gun.
sentences.zh: 她带了一名人质女性一起去，并且随身携带了手枪。

sentences.en: Two policemen thought they could overpower her.
sentences.zh: 两名警察认为他们可以制服她。

sentences.en: They hadn't sought or received permission from their higher-ups to attempt an arrest, but the opportunity seemed too good to resiSt. Another officer confirmed that they
sentences.zh: 他们没有向上级寻求或获得尝试逮捕的批准，但这个机会似乎太诱人了，让人无法抗拒。另一名警员证实他们

sentences.en: should go ahead with the spontaneous plan, telling his colleagues, if it is possible, get her.
sentences.zh: 应该继续执行这个临时计划，他告诉同伴：“如果可能的话，抓住她。”

sentences.en: Four officers stood outside the bathroom and waited.
sentences.zh: 四名警察站在洗手间外面等待。

sentences.en: When they saw Lerblik walk out, they pounced.
sentences.zh: 当他们看到莱尔布利克走出来时，他们扑了上去。

sentences.en: Two policemen grappled with her.
sentences.zh: 两名警察与她厮打起来。

sentences.en: As she started to scream, one placed his hand over her mouth to muffle her cries.
sentences.zh: 当她开始尖叫时，一人用手捂住她的嘴，以压制她的哭喊声。

sentences.en: They successfully wrestled Lerblik to the ground and removed her weapon before slapping handcuffs on her wrists.
sentences.zh: 他们成功将莱尔布利克摔倒在地，缴下了她的武器，然后给她戴上了手铐。

sentences.en: Now they had one of the three wanted individuals in their custody.
sentences.zh: 现在，他们将三名通缉犯中的一人控制住了。

sentences.en: But some were baffled by their decision.
sentences.zh: 但也有人对他们的决定感到不解。

sentences.en: A reporter later asked the question,
sentences.zh: 一名记者后来提出了这样一个问题：

sentences.en: why would you catch the most harmless person out of the three while the other two idiots remained armed in the bus with the hostages?
sentences.zh: “当另外两个混蛋带着人质在车里持有武器时，你们为什么要去抓三个人中最无害的一个？”

sentences.en: Meanwhile, Rosner and Degovsky were waiting for Lerblik to return.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，罗斯纳和德戈夫斯基正在等待莱尔布利克回来。

sentences.en: Minutes ticked by and still there was no sign of her.
sentences.zh: 时间一分钟一分钟地过去，依然不见她的踪影。

sentences.en: A visit to the bathroom shouldn't have taken this long.
sentences.zh: 上个厕所不应该花这么长时间。

sentences.en: Then Rosner heard what sounded like his girlfriend screaming.
sentences.zh: 接着，罗斯纳听到了听起来像是他女友的尖叫声。

sentences.en: It dawned on the two bank robbers that she must have been apprehended.
sentences.zh: 两个劫匪突然意识到，她肯定是被抓了。

sentences.en: Rosner was furious.
sentences.zh: 罗斯纳勃然大怒。

sentences.en: He began ranting.
sentences.zh: 他开始大声咆哮。

sentences.en: They shouldn't have done this.
sentences.zh: 他们不该这么做。

sentences.en: These pigs.
sentences.zh: 这群猪。

sentences.en: These goddamn pigs.
sentences.zh: 这些该死的猪。

sentences.en: These bastards.
sentences.zh: 这群混蛋。

sentences.en: Speaking through photographer Peter Meyer, he issued an ultimatum.
sentences.zh: 他通过摄影师彼得·迈耶传话，发出了最后通牒。

sentences.en: Return his girlfriend in five minutes.
sentences.zh: 在五分钟内放回他的女友。

sentences.en: Or he would shoot a hostage.
sentences.zh: 否则他就会枪杀人质。

sentences.en: A fierce debate ensued between the police officers present.
sentences.zh: 在场的警察之间爆发了激烈的争论。

sentences.en: Not wanting to risk the lives of the hostages, one policeman insisted that Lerblik be released and sent back to her accomplices.
sentences.zh: 为了不拿人质的生命冒险，一名警察坚持释放莱尔布利克，并将其送回同伙身边。

sentences.en: But the two who'd arrested her were reluctant to send her back.
sentences.zh: 但逮捕她的两名警察很不情愿把她送回去。

sentences.en: After some back and forth, they eventually agreed that they couldn't ignore Rosner's demands.
sentences.zh: 经过一番拉锯，他们最终同意无法忽视罗斯纳的要求。

sentences.en: Time was running out and the risk was too great.
sentences.zh: 时间无多，风险太大了。

sentences.en: The key to Lerblik's handcuffs was fetched and the police prepared to let her go.
sentences.zh: 莱尔布利克手铐的钥匙被拿来了，警察准备放她走。

sentences.en: Just as one of the officers went to turn the key, it snapped and broke off inside the lock.
sentences.zh: 就在其中一名警察去转动钥匙时，钥匙突然折断在锁里面了。

sentences.en: Now broken, the key was useless and the handcuffs couldn't be removed.
sentences.zh: 钥匙断了之后就没用了，手铐也无法取下。

sentences.en: The police would have to find another way to remove them.
sentences.zh: 警察必须找到另一种方法来取下手铐。

sentences.en: But, the five minutes Rosner had allotted were almost up.
sentences.zh: 但是，罗斯纳给出的五分钟期限快到了。

sentences.en: Peter Meyer was quickly sent over to the bus to alert the bank robbers that Lerblik was on her way.
sentences.zh: 彼得·迈耶被迅速派往公交车，提醒劫匪莱尔布利克正在路上。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, the police scrambled to remove her handcuffs.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，警察手忙脚乱地想办法解开她的手铐。

sentences.en: Back on the bus, tensions were mounting.
sentences.zh: 回到公交车上，紧张气氛正在升级。

sentences.en: Five minutes had passed since Rosner demanded the return of his girlfriend.
sentences.zh: 自从罗斯纳要求放回女友以来，五分钟已经过去了。

sentences.en: Peter Meyer had shared the police message that Lerblik would be coming back soon, but there was no sign of her.
sentences.zh: 彼得·迈耶已经传达了警察关于莱尔布利克即将回来的消息，但仍不见她的人影。

sentences.en: In a rage, Rosner turned to eight-year-old hostage Tatiana de
sentences.zh: 暴怒之中的罗斯纳转向八岁的人质塔蒂亚娜·德

sentences.en: Georgie, grabbed her arm and dragged her away from her brother.
sentences.zh: 乔治，抓住她的胳膊把她从她哥哥身边拖走。

sentences.en: He pointed his gun at her head.
sentences.zh: 他用枪指着她的头。

sentences.en: Emanuela rushed over and tried to pull his younger sister to safety.
sentences.zh: 埃马努埃拉冲过去，试图把年幼的妹妹拉到安全地带。

sentences.en: Dieter Dagowski turned around to face the two siblings and aimed his gun.
sentences.zh: 迪特尔·达戈夫斯基转过身面对这对兄妹，举起了枪。

sentences.en: Then, he pulled the trigger and fired three times.
sentences.zh: 随后，他扣动扳机，连开三枪。

sentences.en: All of the hostages began screaming.
sentences.zh: 所有人质都尖叫起来。

sentences.en: Tatiana saw her brother crumple in front of her and fall to the floor.
sentences.zh: 塔蒂亚娜眼睁睁地看着哥哥在她面前瘫软倒地。

sentences.en: He had been shot in the head.
sentences.zh: 他的头部中枪了。

sentences.en: One minute later, Marian Lerblik boarded the bus, having been released by the police officers.
sentences.zh: 一分钟后，玛丽安娜·莱尔布利克在被警察释放后登上了公交车。

sentences.en: Having shot a hostage, Rosner and Dagowski were once again eager to hit the road.
sentences.zh: 由于已经枪击了人质，罗斯纳和达戈夫斯基又急于上路了。

sentences.en: With Lerblik returned to them, there was nothing left to wait for.
sentences.zh: 既然莱尔布利克已经回到他们身边，也就没什么好等的了。

sentences.en: The two men pulled Emanuela de
sentences.zh: 这两个男人把埃马努埃拉·德

sentences.en: Georgie's body from the bus and dumped it at the highway rest stop, before speeding away from the scene with their hostages.
sentences.zh: 乔治的尸体从公交车上拖出来，扔在高速公路休息区，然后带着人质加速逃离现场。

sentences.en: The journalists who were covering the unfolding story found Emanuela's body.
sentences.zh: 报道这一事件的记者们发现了埃马努埃拉的尸体。

sentences.en: He was clad in denim jeans and a white t-shirt soaked in blood.
sentences.zh: 他身穿牛仔裤，白色的T恤已经被血浸透。

sentences.en: He looked lifeless, but a check of his vital signs revealed he was still alive, despite sustaining three shots to the head.
sentences.zh: 他看起来毫无生气，但检查生命体征后发现，尽管头部中三枪，他居然还活着。

sentences.en: Two press photographers dragged his body to safety.
sentences.zh: 两名新闻摄影师将他的尸体拖到了安全地带。

sentences.en: News crews filmed them doing so, broadcasting live footage of the wounded and unconscious 15-year-old across the country.
sentences.zh: 新闻摄制组拍下了这一过程，向全国直播了这位受伤且失去知觉的15岁少年的现场画面。

sentences.en: One of the photographers held up Emanuela's head so that the crew could get a better angle of his face.
sentences.zh: 其中一名摄影师托起埃马努埃拉的头部，以便摄制组能拍到他脸部的更好角度。

sentences.en: Inside the service station, an attendant phoned for an ambulance.
sentences.zh: 在服务站内，一名服务员打电话叫了救护车。

sentences.en: It took 20 minutes to arrive.
sentences.zh: 救护车花了20分钟才赶到。

sentences.en: During the wait, Emanuela bled to death.
sentences.zh: 在等待期间，埃马努埃拉流血过多身亡。

sentences.en: Along with 24 other hostages, his little sister was still on board the bus with the men who killed him.
sentences.zh: 连同另外24名人质，他的小妹妹依然和杀死他的那些歹徒一起待在车上。

sentences.en: The bus careened along the autobahn as the bank robbers headed south-weSt. Rosner had decided they should leave
sentences.zh: 大巴在高速公路上失控狂奔，银行劫匪正朝西南方向驶去。罗斯纳决定离开

sentences.en: north-west Germany and make their way to the border with the Netherlands.
sentences.zh: 德国西北部，前往荷兰边境。

sentences.en: He'd heard that police in the neighbouring country were friendlier than those in west Germany and hoped that they might go easier on them.
sentences.zh: 他听说邻国的警察比西德警察更好说话，希望他们能对他们宽容一些。

sentences.en: Some journalists were still enthusiastically pursuing them, following the bus in their cars and taxis.
sentences.zh: 一些记者依然狂热地追踪着他们，开着汽车和小轿车紧跟在大巴后面。

sentences.en: Driving in vehicles behind the media were numerous police officers.
sentences.zh: 在媒体车辆后面行驶的是大批警员。

sentences.en: To their frustration, they couldn't get close to the bus due to the row of cars in front.
sentences.zh: 令他们沮丧的是，由于前方有一排汽车阻挡，他们无法靠近大巴。

sentences.en: At one stage, as many as four press vehicles were driving side by side along the autobahn, making it impossible for the police to overtake them.
sentences.zh: 在一个阶段，多达四辆媒体车辆并排在高速公路上行驶，导致警方根本无法超车。

sentences.en: Despite the fact that law enforcement was prevented from reaching the bus,
sentences.zh: 尽管执法人员无法接近大巴，

sentences.en: Rosner and Dagowski made their hostages stand throughout the journey, just in case the police decided to shoot through the windows.
sentences.zh: 罗斯纳和达戈夫斯基还是强迫所有人在整个行程中站立，以防警方决定隔着车窗开枪。

sentences.en: At one point, a taxi carrying a journalist veered slightly too close to the bus.
sentences.zh: 有一次，一辆搭载记者的出租车离大巴稍微太近了。

sentences.en: This enraged Rosner.
sentences.zh: 这激怒了罗斯纳。

sentences.en: He aimed his gun and fired through a window, shattering the glass.
sentences.zh: 他举起枪隔着车窗开了一枪，玻璃应声碎裂。

sentences.en: When police officers attempted to overtake the reporters and hone in on the bus, they collided with a truck.
sentences.zh: 当警官们试图超过记者并逼近大巴时，他们与一辆卡车相撞了。

sentences.en: One policeman was killed and two others were injured in the collision.
sentences.zh: 这起碰撞导致一名警察丧生，另外两人受伤。

sentences.en: West German police had caught on to the bank robber's plan to flee to the Netherlands and notified customs officials who closed the border.
sentences.zh: 西德警方识破了银行劫匪逃往荷兰的计划，并通知了海关官员关闭边境。

sentences.en: While the bus would be permitted to cross, the journalists following it would not.
sentences.zh: 虽然大巴将被允许通行，但尾随其后的记者则不行。

sentences.en: At about 2.30am on Thursday August 18, the bus reached the border.
sentences.zh: 8月18日星期四凌晨2点30分左右，大巴抵达边境。

sentences.en: The two bank robbers crossed over into the Netherlands and parked the bus in a remote forest near the town of Aldenzaal.
sentences.zh: 这两名银行劫匪进入了荷兰境内，并将大巴停在阿尔登扎尔镇附近的一处偏僻森林里。

sentences.en: Dutch police officers were waiting for them.
sentences.zh: 荷兰警察已经在那里等着他们了。

sentences.en: They quickly informed Rosner and Dagowski that they would not enter into any negotiations with them as long as they were holding children hostage.
sentences.zh: 他们迅速告知罗斯纳和达戈夫斯基，只要他们还扣押着儿童人质，他们就不会与他们进行任何谈判。

sentences.en: A standoff ensued.
sentences.zh: 对峙随即展开。

sentences.en: After almost three hours, the two bank robbers finally agreed to release the children.
sentences.zh: 经过将近三个小时，这两名银行劫匪终于同意释放儿童。

sentences.en: At 5.15am, three children, including Tatiana de Georgie and two women, were allowed to disembark the bus.
sentences.zh: 清晨5点15分，包括塔蒂亚娜·德·乔治在内的三名儿童以及两名妇女被允许下车。

sentences.en: Now, the Dutch police were willing to negotiate.
sentences.zh: 此时，荷兰警方愿意进行谈判了。

sentences.en: Rosner and Dagowski wanted a new vehicle, a high-powered BMW.
sentences.zh: 罗斯纳和达戈夫斯基想要一辆新车，一辆高性能的宝马。

sentences.en: If they received that, then they would free even more hostages.
sentences.zh: 如果他们得到这辆车，他们就会释放更多人质。

sentences.en: German police set about preparing a dark grey BMW 735i.
sentences.zh: 德国警方着手准备了一辆深灰色宝马735i。

sentences.en: Unbeknownst to the bank robbers, they arranged it so that the vehicle's engine could be stopped via a remote control in their possession.
sentences.zh: 劫匪们并不知道，警方做了手脚，可以通过他们手中的遥控器关闭这辆车的发动机。

sentences.en: Although customs officials had closed the border, some journalists had been able to sneak across via back roads and alternate routes.
sentences.zh: 尽管海关官员关闭了边境，但一些记者还是通过小路和替代路线偷偷潜了过来。

sentences.en: Hundreds of German and Dutch reporters had descended on the scene to report live and snap more photographs of the ongoing crisis.
sentences.zh: 数百名德国和荷兰记者蜂拥至现场进行现场报道，并为这场持续中的危机拍摄更多照片。

sentences.en: Dutch police were keeping a close eye on the bus and had orders to apprehend if the perpetrators attempted violence.
sentences.zh: 荷兰警方正密切监视着大巴，并下达了指令：如果行凶者企图施暴，就将其逮捕。

sentences.en: Then,
sentences.zh: 就在这时，

sentences.en: Rosner's gun accidentally went off and Lerblik was hit in the leg.
sentences.zh: 罗斯纳的枪走火了，莱尔布利克的大腿被击中。

sentences.en: Thinking he was purposely shooting, officers started firing back.
sentences.zh: 警官们以为他是故意开枪，于是开始开枪还击。

sentences.en: Hostages flung themselves to the floor as bullets rained on the bus.
sentences.zh: 子弹如雨点般倾泻在大巴上，人质们纷纷扑倒在车厢地板上。

sentences.en: Rosner began screaming into the police radio he'd been given.
sentences.zh: 罗斯纳对着警方给他的对讲机大喊大叫。

sentences.en: That was not against you.
sentences.zh: 那不是针对你的。

sentences.en: It happened accidentally.
sentences.zh: 那是意外发生的。

sentences.en: Eventually, police ceased fire and the air fell silent.
sentences.zh: 最终，警方停止了射击，空气重归寂静。

sentences.en: The bus was now riddled with bullets.
sentences.zh: 此时这辆公交车已经弹痕累累。

sentences.en: Due to the damage and the fact they were getting a new getaway car, Rosner and Dagowski agreed to free almost all of their 20 remaining hostages.
sentences.zh: 由于车辆受损，加之他们要换一辆新的逃逸车辆，罗斯纳和达戈夫斯基同意释放剩下的约20名人质中的几乎所有人。

sentences.en: However, they still wanted to hold on to two of them as a precaution.
sentences.zh: 不过，为了谨慎起见，他们仍想扣留其中两人。

sentences.en: They selected 18-year-old friends Silke Bischoff and Enos Voitler.
sentences.zh: 他们选中了18岁的好友希尔克·比肖夫和埃诺斯·福伊特勒。

sentences.en: At 6.30am, the BMW was delivered.
sentences.zh: 早上6点30分，宝马车送到了。

sentences.en: The men forced Silke and Enos inside, along with Marian Lerblik.
sentences.zh: 两人强行将希尔克和埃诺斯塞进车内，同行的还有玛丽安·莱布利克。

sentences.en: Then they sped off once again.
sentences.zh: 随后他们再次加速驶离。

sentences.en: Initially, they headed west towards Amsterdam, the capital of the Netherlands, with Dutch investigators in hot pursuit.
sentences.zh: 起初，他们向西开往荷兰首都阿姆斯特丹，荷兰调查人员紧追不舍。

sentences.en: But then they suddenly turned and began making their way back towards West Germany.
sentences.zh: 但接着他们突然掉头，开始往西德方向折返。

sentences.en: Just after 7am, they crossed over the German border.
sentences.zh: 刚过早上7点，他们穿过了德国边境。

sentences.en: They raced through the state of North Rhine-Vestphalia until they reached the city of Cologne.
sentences.zh: 他们在北莱茵-威斯特法伦州疾驰，直到抵达科隆市。

sentences.en: Cologne is the fourth most popular city in Germany.
sentences.zh: 科隆是德国第四大城市。

sentences.en: Due to heavy bombing during World War II, it required significant reconstruction during the post-war years through to the late 20th century.
sentences.zh: 由于在二战期间遭受严重轰炸，它在战后到20世纪末经历了大规模重建。

sentences.en: By the end of the 1980s, the rebuilding of Cologne's most famous landmarks was almost complete.
sentences.zh: 到20世纪80年代末，科隆最著名地标的重建工作已基本完成。

sentences.en: When the bank robbers and their hostages reached the city, it was mid-morning on
sentences.zh: 当银行劫匪和人质抵达该市时，时间正值

sentences.en: Thursday August 18.
sentences.zh: 8月18日星期四的上午。

sentences.en: Once again, they had been followed by an entourage of journalists and police.
sentences.zh: 他们再次被大批记者和警察一路尾随。

sentences.en: As soon as they parked their car in a popular shopping district at the city's centre, they were surrounded by reporters.
sentences.zh: 他们的车刚停在市中心一个热门商业区，就立刻被记者包围了。

sentences.en: Curious onlookers who'd heard reports that the country's most wanted felons had arrived in town also congregated in the area to catch a glimpse.
sentences.zh: 听到全国头号通缉犯抵城的报道后，出于好奇的围观群众也聚集到该地区一探究竟。

sentences.en: The hostage situation and associated media circus made for a strange sight on the busy city streets.
sentences.zh: 人质事件和随之而来的媒体狂欢在繁华的城市街道上构成了一幅奇异的景象。

sentences.en: Pedestrians were bustling about and nearby, a folk band was busking.
sentences.zh: 行人行色匆匆，不远处还有民间乐队在卖艺街头。

sentences.en: Rosner got out of the car and walked to a nearby bakery where he purchased some bread rolls.
sentences.zh: 罗斯纳下车走到附近的一家面包店买了一些面包卷。

sentences.en: Then he headed back to the BMW and sat behind the wheel next to his girlfriend.
sentences.zh: 然后他回到宝马车旁，坐在他女友身旁的驾驶座上。

sentences.en: Dozens and dozens of journalists had swarmed around the BMW, some leaning across its bonnet and pressing against its sides.
sentences.zh: 成群结队的记者蜂拥围住宝马车，一些人甚至趴在车头上，紧贴着车身。

sentences.en: The air inside the car grew stuffy as bodies crowded around it.
sentences.zh: 随着人群围拢过来，车内空气变得闷热起来。

sentences.en: Microphones and cameras were shoved through the open windows.
sentences.zh: 麦克风和摄像机从打开的车窗里塞了进来。

sentences.en: The journalists surrounding the car inadvertently provided a protective barrier and made it impossible for police to approach.
sentences.zh: 围在车周围的记者无意中构筑了一道防护屏障，让警方无法靠近。

sentences.en: Dagowski remained in the back of the vehicle, wedged between Silke and Ennis.
sentences.zh: 达戈夫斯基则留在车后座，挤在希尔克和埃尼斯之间。

sentences.en: While chain-smoking cigarettes and casually holding a pistol in his right hand.
sentences.zh: 他一边一支接一支地抽着烟，一边漫不经心地右手握着一把手枪。

sentences.en: Occasionally he used a pair of binoculars to peer out the rear window, keeping his eyes peeled for police.
sentences.zh: 他时不时用望远镜观察后车窗外的情况，时刻警惕着警察。

sentences.en: When a reporter asked Rosner what they were doing in the city, Silke sarcastically quipped from the back seat,
sentences.zh: 当有记者问罗斯纳他们来这座城市做什么时，希尔克在后座上讽刺地插话道：

sentences.en: visiting the cathedral of Cologne.
sentences.zh: 参观科隆大教堂。

sentences.en: Rosner explained that they had been thwarted at every turn by German police refusing to negotiate.
sentences.zh: 罗斯纳解释说，德国警方拒绝谈判，导致他们处处受阻。

sentences.en: Marion Lerblick expressed her regret that Emanuela de Giorgi had been killed, but blamed law enforcement for detaining her instead of the two men.
sentences.zh: 马里恩·莱布利克对埃马努埃拉·德焦尔吉被杀表示遗憾，但指责执法部门扣留了她而不是这两个男人。

sentences.en: She insisted that they were looking after Silke and Ennis, adding,
sentences.zh: 她坚称他们一直在照顾希尔克和埃尼斯，并补充说

sentences.en: We are not harming them, and we don't want to harm them.
sentences.zh: 我们没有伤害他们，也不想伤害他们。

sentences.en: Rosner was aware that he and Dagowski would be facing enormous ramifications for murdering Emanuela.
sentences.zh: 罗斯纳很清楚，他和达戈夫斯基将为谋杀埃曼努拉承担极其严重的后果。

sentences.en: He expressed his frustration at the now two-day ordeal, but said that if the police tried to arrest them, they would kill both hostages, then take their own lives.
sentences.zh: 他表达了对这场已持续两天的折磨的沮丧，但也表示如果警察试图逮捕他们，他们就会杀死两名人质，然后自杀。

sentences.en: He placed the barrel of the gun in his mouth to prove how serious he was.
sentences.zh: 他把枪口放进嘴里，以证明自己是认真的。

sentences.en: Dagowski agreed with his accomplice, stating,
sentences.zh: 达戈夫斯基附和着同伙的话，说道：

sentences.en: We aren't going to negotiate with police anymore because we know that leads to nothing.
sentences.zh: 我们不会再跟警察谈判了，因为我们知道那根本没用。

sentences.en: I want to say through the news media that the police should back off.
sentences.zh: 我想通过新闻媒体告诉警察，让他们往后退。

sentences.en: As he chatted with the journalists, he nonchalantly pressed his gun to Silke's neck and head.
sentences.zh: 在与记者闲聊时，他漫不经心地将枪顶在锡尔克的脖子和头上。

sentences.en: At one point, a reporter complained that he hadn't gotten the picture he wanted and demanded, Hold the gun to her temple again.
sentences.zh: 有一次，一名记者抱怨没拍到想要的照片，并要求道：把枪再举到她的太阳穴上。

sentences.en: I don't have a photograph yet.
sentences.zh: 我还拍不到照片。

sentences.en: Silke still looked calm and occasionally even managed to give a small smile.
sentences.zh: 锡尔克看起来依然很镇定，偶尔甚至还能勉强挤出一丝微笑。

sentences.en: Only her wide eyes occasionally betrayed a hint of alarm.
sentences.zh: 只有她睁大的双眼偶尔会流露出一丝惊恐。

sentences.en: When a reporter asked Silke how she was holding up, she said she was fine.
sentences.zh: 当记者问锡尔克情况如何时，她说自己很好。

sentences.en: However, she was worried that the police would ignore the bank robber's demands, which could lead to another person being killed.
sentences.zh: 然而，她担心警察会忽视劫匪的要求，从而导致另一个人被杀。

sentences.en: She pleaded,
sentences.zh: 她恳求道：

sentences.en: Just do what they request and don't try to interfere.
sentences.zh: 照他们要求的做，别去干扰他们。

sentences.en: I'm scared of that.
sentences.zh: 我很担心这一点。

sentences.en: The two bank robbers gave interview after interview.
sentences.zh: 这两名劫匪接连接受了一个又一个采访。

sentences.en: Reporters helped them by supplying cups of coffee and attempting to negotiate on their behalf, suggesting they trade their hostages for police officers.
sentences.zh: 记者们通过提供咖啡杯并试图代为谈判来帮助他们，建议他们用人质交换警察。

sentences.en: When plain clothes officers were sent over in the hopes they might be able to get closer than their uniformed counterparts, some journalists pointed them out to the bank robbers.
sentences.zh: 当便衣警察被派过去，希望能比穿制服的同行靠得更近时，一些记者却把他们指认给了劫匪。

sentences.en: Rosner was queried as to what would happen if the police attempted anything.
sentences.zh: 有人问罗斯纳，如果警察采取行动会发生什么。

sentences.en: He simply answered,
sentences.zh: 他简单地回答道：

sentences.en: Then there's going to be a bloodbath here.
sentences.zh: 那这里就会血流成河。

sentences.en: Earlier that morning, Udu Rawbell, the deputy editor of the
sentences.zh: 那天早些时候，《科隆每日快报》副总编

sentences.en: Cologne Daily Express, had headed to his local tennis club for a friendly game.
sentences.zh: 乌杜·拉贝尔前往当地的网球俱乐部进行一场友谊赛。

sentences.en: He'd taken some time off from work and hadn't watched television or listened to the radio for a couple of days.
sentences.zh: 他从工作中请了一段时间的假，已经两三天没看电视或听收音机了。

sentences.en: As Rawbell headed into the club's cafeteria, his attention was drawn to a TV set showing the morning news.
sentences.zh: 当拉贝尔走进俱乐部的自助餐厅时，他的注意力被一台播放着早间新闻的电视机吸引了。

sentences.en: For the first time, he learnt of the events that had gripped Western Germany over the past two days.
sentences.zh: 他第一次知道了过去两天里震惊西德的事件。

sentences.en: Realising he was missing out on one of the country's biggest stories, he raced to his car and headed downtown.
sentences.zh: 意识到自己错过了国内最大的新闻之一，他冲向汽车，驶向市中心。

sentences.en: Soon, he'd joined the enormous crowd of reporters gathered around the bank robbers' BMW.
sentences.zh: 很快，他便加入了聚集在劫匪宝马车周围的庞大记者群。

sentences.en: Rawbell managed to push his way to the car to speak with Rosner and Dagowski directly.
sentences.zh: 拉贝尔设法挤到车前，直接与罗斯纳和达戈夫斯基对话。

sentences.en: He soon established a rapport with the bank robbers.
sentences.zh: 他很快与这两名劫匪建立了融洽的关系。

sentences.en: He could tell that both men were growing increasingly agitated and the situation was becoming more dangerous with every passing second.
sentences.zh: 他看得出两个人都越来越焦虑，随着时间一分一秒过去，情况变得越来越危险。

sentences.en: Rawbell tried to create some space around the vehicle.
sentences.zh: 拉贝尔试图在车周围腾出一些空间。

sentences.en: He began waving his arms, motioning to the other journalists around him to move back.
sentences.zh: 他开始挥舞手臂，示意周围的其他记者往后退。

sentences.en: When they were reluctant to do so, he tried pushing them away.
sentences.zh: 当他们不愿意照做时，他便试图把他们推开。

sentences.en: Some of the undercover officers in the crowd began wondering if now was their moment to strike.
sentences.zh: 人群中的一些便衣警察开始琢磨，现在是不是他们行动的时机。

sentences.en: One officer had succeeded in getting within touching distance of the bank robbers and thought an arrest could be possible.
sentences.zh: 一名警官成功接近到触手可及的劫匪距离，并认为逮捕是有可能的。

sentences.en: But they suspected the risk was still too great.
sentences.zh: 但他们怀疑风险仍然太大。

sentences.en: All of a sudden, Rosner leapt from the car and aimed his gun at the crowd.
sentences.zh: 突然间，罗斯纳从车里跳出来，把枪指向人群。

sentences.en: Anxiously, he turned to Udu Rawbell and asked how to get to the autobahn, adding,
sentences.zh: 他焦急地转向乌杜·拉贝尔，询问去高速公路怎么走，并补充道：

sentences.en: We've got to get out of here now.
sentences.zh: 我们现在必须离开这里。

sentences.en: My buddy is about to lose it completely.
sentences.zh: 我的同伴快要完全失控了。

sentences.en: Rawbell began describing the fastest route, but Rosner was impatient.
sentences.zh: 拉贝尔开始描述最快的路线，但罗斯纳很不耐烦。

sentences.en: He asked Rawbell to get in the car and direct them there himself.
sentences.zh: 他要求拉贝尔上车，亲自带路。

sentences.en: Rawbell was uncertain.
sentences.zh: 拉贝尔有些犹豫。

sentences.en: The situation was rapidly spiralling out of control and there was every possibility it could end in disaster.
sentences.zh: 局势正在迅速失控，完全有可能以悲剧收场。

sentences.en: However, he also realised that this was a unique opportunity to cover the story in a way none of the other journalists could.
sentences.zh: 然而，他也意识到这是一个千载难逢的机会，能够以其他记者无法企及的方式报道这则新闻。

sentences.en: In a split second, Rawbell had made up his mind.
sentences.zh: 在电光石火之间，拉贝尔下定了决心。

sentences.en: He climbed into the back seat of the car and took a seat next to Silke Bischoff.
sentences.zh: 他钻进汽车后座，坐在锡尔克·比肖夫旁边。

sentences.en: Casefile will be back shortly.
sentences.zh: 案情档案节目稍后回来。

sentences.en: Thank you for supporting us by listening to this episode's sponsors.
sentences.zh: 感谢您通过收听本期节目的赞助商来支持我们。

sentences.en: Thank you for listening to this episode's ads.
sentences.zh: 感谢您收听本期节目的广告。

sentences.en: By supporting our sponsors, you support Casefile to continue to deliver quality content.
sentences.zh: 通过支持我们的赞助商，您就是在支持案情档案继续为您提供优质内容。

sentences.en: Rosner slowly pulled the car away from the crowd and left the crowded city streets, following Rawbell's directions to the autobahn.
sentences.zh: 罗斯纳缓缓将车驶离人群，离开拥挤的城市街道，按照拉贝尔的指示开往高速公路。

sentences.en: Rawbell chatted openly as they drove.
sentences.zh: 车子行驶时，拉贝尔大方地闲聊起来。

sentences.en: He assumed that police had bugged the car and hoped he might be able to coke some useful information out of the two felons.
sentences.zh: 他猜测警察在车里装了窃听器，希望从这两个罪犯口中套出一些有用的信息。

sentences.en: But his attempts at conversation annoyed
sentences.zh: 但他的攀谈惹恼了

sentences.en: Dagowski.
sentences.zh: 达戈夫斯基。

sentences.en: He pointed his gun at the journalist and demanded that he shut up.
sentences.zh: 他将枪指向记者，命令他闭嘴。

sentences.en: After that, the group travelled in silence.
sentences.zh: 此后，一行人在沉默中前行。

sentences.en: The bank robbers had no particular destination in mind as they sped in a south-east direction.
sentences.zh: 劫匪朝东南方向疾驰时，并没有特定的目的地。

sentences.en: Although driving along the autobahn left them exposed, it also allowed them to monitor those who were following them.
sentences.zh: 尽管沿高速公路行驶让他们暴露在外，但也让他们能够监视那些追踪他们的人。

sentences.en: Yet again, the press and the police were hot on the bank robbers' heels.
sentences.zh: 新闻记者和警方又一次紧追劫匪不放。

sentences.en: Between 20 and 30 vehicles were following the BMW.
sentences.zh: 20到30辆车正在追踪这辆宝马。

sentences.en: Law enforcement arranged for the autobahn to be shut down in one direction so no one else could join the chase.
sentences.zh: 执法部门安排将高速公路的一个方向封闭，以免其他人加入追捕。

sentences.en: After about 40 minutes, the BMW reached a service station outside the city of Zygborg.
sentences.zh: 大约40分钟后，宝马车抵达锡格堡市外的一个服务区。

sentences.en: Rosner and Dagowski pulled over and kicked Rawbell out of the car, having got what they needed from him.
sentences.zh: 罗斯纳和达戈夫斯基将车停下，把拉贝尔赶下了车，因为他们已经从他那里得到了所需的东西。

sentences.en: The journalist stood watching as the BMW took off again.
sentences.zh: 这名记者站在原地，看着宝马车再次疾驰而去。

sentences.en: When news crews arrived at the location shortly after, they conducted a live interview with him.
sentences.zh: 不久后，当新闻摄制组赶到现场时，对进行了一次现场采访。

sentences.en: He described Dagowski as
sentences.zh: 他形容达戈夫斯基

sentences.en: completely on the edge, exhausted and ready for anything.
sentences.zh: 情绪彻底崩溃、精疲力竭且什么都做得出来。

sentences.en: He said that he has nothing to lose.
sentences.zh: 他说他已经没有什么好失去的了。

sentences.en: He's shot a 15-year-old and he's not going to prison for a life sentence.
sentences.zh: 他枪杀了一个15岁的女孩，是不会去坐无期徒刑的牢的。

sentences.en: There is going to be a blood bath if the police don't leave them alone.
sentences.zh: 如果警察不离他们远点，就会发生血流成河的惨剧。

sentences.en: He asked me to pass this on to the police and press.
sentences.zh: 他让我把这些转达给警察和媒体。

sentences.en: As he spoke, Rawbell suddenly felt himself go weak at the knees.
sentences.zh: 正说着，拉贝尔突然感到双腿发软。

sentences.en: The reality of what had happened and the fact that he could have been killed suddenly sunk in.
sentences.zh: 发生的一切以及他差点丧命的事实突然涌上心头。

sentences.en: He was notified that police officers were on their way to obtain a statement from him, but all he could think about was the article he planned to write detailing his experience.
sentences.zh: 有人通知他说警察正在路上找他做笔录，但他满脑子想的都是他打算写的那篇详述自己经历的文章。

sentences.en: The BMW continued along the autobahn.
sentences.zh: 宝马车继续在高速公路上行驶。

sentences.en: Rosner was driving south, straight towards the neighbouring state of Rhineland Palatinate.
sentences.zh: 罗斯纳向南驾车，径直驶向邻近的莱茵兰-普法尔茨州。

sentences.en: As they drove, Dagowski leaned over and whispered in hostage
sentences.zh: 车行途中，达戈夫斯基俯身在人质

sentences.en: Enos' ear that they were sorry for having taken them, especially given the girl's young age.
sentences.zh: 埃诺斯的耳边低声道歉，称不该绑架他们，尤其是考虑到女孩年纪还小。

sentences.en: He told her that he and Rosner would pull over somewhere and release them once they were in the next state and night had fallen.
sentences.zh: 他告诉她，一旦进入下一个州且夜幕降临，他和罗斯纳就会在某个地方停车放他们走。

sentences.en: Enos and Silke felt a sense of relief.
sentences.zh: 埃诺斯和锡尔克感到一阵释怀。

sentences.en: They relaxed enough to sip on some cans of beer as the car travelled along the highway, with the two girls drinking a toast to her happy ending.
sentences.zh: 随着汽车在高速公路上行驶，她们放松到甚至开始啜饮罐装啤酒，两个女孩还为美好的结局举杯庆祝。

sentences.en: Law enforcement was still in hot pursuit.
sentences.zh: 执法部门依然在紧追不舍。

sentences.en: By now, it had been 54 hours since the bank hold-up in Gladbeck and patience was wearing thin.
sentences.zh: 此时距离格拉德贝克的银行劫案已经过去54小时，大家的耐心正在消磨殆尽。

sentences.en: Police had missed one opportunity after another to apprehend the bank robbers.
sentences.zh: 警方一次又一次错失抓获劫匪的机会。

sentences.en: The fact that they'd killed a 15-year-old in cold blood proved how dangerous they were.
sentences.zh: 他们冷血杀害一名15岁女孩的事实证明了他们有多危险。

sentences.en: An order had finally been sent from operational headquarters, dictating that they mustn't be allowed to flee to any more cities.
sentences.zh: 作战指挥部终于下达了命令，指示绝不能再让他们逃往任何其他城市。

sentences.en: The perpetrators must be apprehended as soon as possible.
sentences.zh: 必须尽快将犯罪分子捉拿归案。

sentences.en: The leader of Cologne's SE car unit objected, believing that the risk to the hostages was still too great.
sentences.zh: 科隆特别行动队的车队负责人对此表示反对，认为对人质的风险仍然太大。

sentences.en: But he was overruled.
sentences.zh: 但他的意见被驳回了。

sentences.en: Several armoured Mercedes were dispatched with the aim of intercepting the BMW and running it off the road.
sentences.zh: 几辆装甲奔驰车被派出，目的是拦截宝马并将其逼出路面。

sentences.en: An ambush site was set up several kilometres from the state line.
sentences.zh: 距离州界几公里处设置了一个伏击点。

sentences.en: And just across the border, the Rhineland
sentences.zh: 就在国境线对面，莱茵兰

sentences.en: Palatinate SE car were poised and ready to strike.
sentences.zh: 普法尔茨州的特别行动队车队也已严阵以待。

sentences.en: Before the BMW had been given to Rosner and Dagowski, police outfitted it with a device that would allow them to cut the engine using a remote control.
sentences.zh: 在把宝马交给罗斯纳和达戈夫斯基之前，警方在车上安装了一个可以通过遥控器切断发动机的装置。

sentences.en: However, the remote had accidentally been left behind with some other officers who were further back on the autobahn.
sentences.zh: 然而，遥控器不小心留在了高速公路后方的一些其他警察那里。

sentences.en: It wouldn't work from such a distance, and this meant that they'd had to quickly devise a backup plan.
sentences.zh: 这么远的距离根本无法起作用，这意味着他们必须迅速设计一个备用计划。

sentences.en: By 1.45pm, the BMW was just a few kilometres from the state border.
sentences.zh: 到下午1点45分，宝马车距离州界仅剩几公里。

sentences.en: Helicopters were flying overhead, and hundreds of spectators had gathered on a nearby bridge above the highway to observe the pursuit.
sentences.zh: 直升机在头顶盘旋，数百名旁观者聚集在高速公路上方附近的一座桥上观看追捕过程。

sentences.en: Dozens of journalists were also at the scene, still following the story.
sentences.zh: 数十名记者也赶到现场，继续追踪报道。

sentences.en: On the other side of the highway, drivers had stopped their cars so they could watch too.
sentences.zh: 在高速公路的另一侧，司机们也把车停下来观看。

sentences.en: Suddenly, officers were given the go-ahead to attack.
sentences.zh: 突然，警员们得到了进攻的批准。

sentences.en: A grey Mercedes zeroed in on the
sentences.zh: 一辆灰色奔驰锁定

sentences.en: BMW and rammed it from one side, sending it skidding.
sentences.zh: 宝马并从一侧撞击它，导致其打滑。

sentences.en: Next, police threw flash grenades to stun the felons with blinding flashes of light.
sentences.zh: 接着，警察投掷了闪光弹，用刺眼的强光使罪犯昏迷。

sentences.en: The BMW came to a complete stop.
sentences.zh: 宝马车彻底停了下来。

sentences.en: Inside,
sentences.zh: 车内，

sentences.en: Rosner and Dagowski began shouting.
sentences.zh: 罗斯纳和达戈夫斯基开始大喊大叫。

sentences.en: Silke appeared to sense that something awful was about to happen.
sentences.zh: 锡尔克似乎预感到可怕的事情即将发生。

sentences.en: Her voice was gripped with fear as she screamed at her friend,
sentences.zh: 她声音中充满恐惧，冲着她的同伴尖叫道：

sentences.en: ''Jump out, Enos.
sentences.zh: “跳出去，埃诺斯。

sentences.en: Jump.'' Enos scrambled to find the handle on the car door nearest to her and yanked it open.
sentences.zh: 跳。”埃诺斯手忙脚乱地寻找离她最近的车门把手，猛地把它拽开。

sentences.en: She leapt out, then scurried to a nearby ditch and clambered inside.
sentences.zh: 她跳了出去，然后快步跑向附近的一个沟渠并爬了进去。

sentences.en: As she lay there, she heard the sound of gunshots ringing out.
sentences.zh: 当她躺在那里时，她听到了一阵枪声响起。

sentences.en: Rosner, Dagowski and the police were all shooting at one another.
sentences.zh: 罗斯纳、达戈夫斯基和警察都在互相射击。

sentences.en: Between 20 to 30 shots were fired.
sentences.zh: 双方总共开了20到30枪。

sentences.en: Then, finally, there was a heavy silence.
sentences.zh: 然后，终于陷入了一片沉寂。

sentences.en: Police had managed to hit Rosner and Dagowski, subduing both men.
sentences.zh: 警方成功击中了罗斯纳和达戈夫斯基，将两人制服。

sentences.en: When they raced over to the
sentences.zh: 当他们冲向

sentences.en: BMW, they found the two felons had sustained significant injuries.
sentences.zh: 宝马时，发现两名罪犯都受到了重伤。

sentences.en: Enos Voigtler had managed to escape the vehicle and was lying in a ditch by the road.
sentences.zh: 埃诺斯·福格特设法逃出了车外，正躺在路边的沟渠里。

sentences.en: She'd suffered minor injuries, as had Marion Lerblick.
sentences.zh: 她受了轻伤，玛丽昂·莱尔布利克也是如此。

sentences.en: Silke Bischoff was still in the back seat of the car.
sentences.zh: 锡尔克·比肖夫依然坐在汽车后座上。

sentences.en: There was a bullet wound in her cheSt. An officer frantically performed CPR on Silke as medical assistants' helicopters and ambulances sped to the scene.
sentences.zh: 她的胸部有一个枪伤。当医疗助手的直升机和救护车呼啸着赶到现场时，一名警员正拼命为锡尔克做心肺复苏。

sentences.en: When they arrived, they rushed to the car while shouting at the police, ''What have you guys done here?''
sentences.zh: 他们到达后，冲向汽车并对警察大喊：“你们在这里干了什么？”

sentences.en: They were unable to revive Silke.
sentences.zh: 他们没能救活锡尔克。

sentences.en: She had been shot directly in the heart and had died.
sentences.zh: 她直接中弹击中心脏，已经身亡。

sentences.en: Her body was covered with a sheet.
sentences.zh: 她的遗体被一块床单盖住。

sentences.en: Rosner and Dagowski were quickly handcuffed and forced to lie face down on the road, with their noses pressed against the bitumen.
sentences.zh: 罗斯纳和达戈夫斯基很快被戴上手铐，被迫脸朝下趴在马路上，鼻子紧贴着沥青路面。

sentences.en: Marion Lerblick was also arrested.
sentences.zh: 玛丽昂·莱尔布利克也被逮捕了。

sentences.en: Other officers made a beeline towards the many members of the press who were standing nearby, filming and photographing everything.
sentences.zh: 其他警察径直走向站在附近拍摄一切的众多媒体人员。

sentences.en: A photographer had his camera snatched from him, with the officer alleging that he was documenting a police investigation without permission.
sentences.zh: 一名摄影师的相机被抢走，警员指控他在未获许可的情况下记录警方调查。

sentences.en: The photographer was warned that he would be arrested if he didn't leave.
sentences.zh: 摄影师被警告称如果不离开就会被捕。

sentences.en: He managed to hide a roll of film that he'd already shot, but lost the second role that was still inside the camera.
sentences.zh: 他设法藏起了一卷已经拍过的胶卷，但丢了另一卷仍在相机里的胶卷。

sentences.en: A police spokesperson addressed the press, informing them that a hostage had been killed.
sentences.zh: 警方发言人向媒体发表讲话，告知他们一名人质被杀。

sentences.en: Journalist Udu Rawbell had gone to a local police station to file a report about his time with the bank robbers when he heard the news that Silke Bischoff had died.
sentences.zh: 记者乌杜·拉贝尔前往当地警察局做关于他与劫匪在一起经历的笔录时，听到了锡尔克·比肖夫身亡的消息。

sentences.en: He felt a sense of shock wash over him, having been seated in the car with both girls not long earlier.
sentences.zh: 一股震惊感向他袭来，不久前他才和两个女孩一起坐在车里。

sentences.en: When he later went back to his office to finish his article for the following day's paper, he tried to
sentences.zh: 当他后来回到办公室完成第二天报纸的文章时，他试图

sentences.en: write it from the point of view of Silke, imagining how the last moments of her life played out.
sentences.zh: 从锡尔克的角度来写，想象她生命中最后时刻的场景。

sentences.en: Silke
sentences.zh: 锡尔克

sentences.en: Bischoff's parents hadn't even known that their daughter had been taken hostage until earlier that day.
sentences.zh: 比肖夫的父母直到那天早些时候都不知道他们的女儿被绑架了。

sentences.en: Although she hadn't returned home on Wednesday August 17, they weren't concerned as they believed she was staying at her boyfriend's house.
sentences.zh: 尽管她在8月17日星期三没有回家，但他们并不担心，因为他们以为她呆在男友家里。

sentences.en: They'd only learnt the truth that morning upon seeing the front page of their local newspaper.
sentences.zh: 他们直到那天早晨看到当地报纸的头版才得知真相。

sentences.en: It showed a photograph of Silke sitting in the back seat of a car with a gun held to her neck.
sentences.zh: 上面刊登了一张照片，显示锡尔克坐在汽车后座上，脖子上被架着一把枪。

sentences.en: She was tilting her head back, her expression blank, as Dagowski watched her with a cigarette hanging from his mouth.
sentences.zh: 她把头向后仰，表情茫然，而达戈夫斯基嘴里叼着烟注视着她。

sentences.en: After that, her devastated family had monitored every second of the situation.
sentences.zh: 在那之后，她心碎的家人密切关注着局势的每一秒。

sentences.en: When Silke's mother Karen found out her daughter and Enos were the last two remaining hostages, she became utterly terrified at what might happen next.
sentences.zh: 当丝尔克的母亲卡伦发现女儿和埃诺斯是仅存的两名人质时，她对接下来可能发生的事情感到无比恐惧。

sentences.en: When the family saw footage of the collision and subsequent shootout on the autobahn, they sat together and prayed for Silke to survive.
sentences.zh: 当家人看到高速公路上碰撞和随后的枪战画面时，他们坐在一起为丝尔克的生还祈祷。

sentences.en: Two hours later, a police representative dressed entirely in black knocked on their front door.

sentences.en: I wouldn't have coped in the way she did.
sentences.zh: “换作我，我绝对无法像她那样应对。”

sentences.en: At the beginning, I used to have nightmares because of that picture.
sentences.zh: “起初，我经常因为那张照片而做噩梦。”

sentences.en: I can handle it today.
sentences.zh: “我今天已经能释怀了。”

sentences.en: It's still painful, but I don't have to look away now.
sentences.zh: “虽然依然痛苦，但我现在不用再把视线移开了。”
